domains.name: transaction
domains.description: Core payment transaction processing owning the full lifecycle from authorization, capture, clearing, settlement instruction, and reconciliation. SSOT for all payment events processed through ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 message flows, real-time authorization decisions, batch processing records, TPS metrics, STP rates, and multi-currency transaction data across card-present, card-not-present, and digital payment channels.

products.name: instrument_issuance
products.description: Transactional record capturing the issuance event of a payment instrument — card printing and dispatch, virtual card generation, ACH account enrollment, or token provisioning. Stores issuance date, issuance channel (branch, online, mobile, API), issuing entity, fulfillment method (instant issue, mail, digital), delivery address reference, activation deadline, and issuance status. Provides the authoritative issuance audit trail per PCI DSS and regulatory requirements.

attributes.description: System‑generated unique identifier for the instrument issuance event.

attributes.name: delivery_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the address where a physical instrument (card, letter) is to be sent.

attributes.name: issuing_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (bank, fintech, or partner) that issued the instrument.

attributes.name: original_issuance_instrument_issuance_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original issuance record when this is a re‑issue.

attributes.name: transaction_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch run that processed this issuance (e.g., nightly settlement batch).

attributes.name: activation_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the instrument must be activated before it expires or is de‑provisioned.

attributes.name: aml_check_status
attributes.description: Outcome of Anti‑Money‑Laundering screening for the issuance.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.business_glossary_term: Issuance Channel (e.g., Branch, Online, Mobile, API, Partner)
attributes.description: The delivery channel through which the issuance request originated.

attributes.name: compliance_review_status
attributes.description: Overall compliance review result for the issuance (PCI, regulatory).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the instrument is no longer valid for transactions.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fulfillment Method (e.g., Instant, Mail, Digital, Pickup)
attributes.description: Method used to deliver the physical or digital instrument to the holder.

attributes.name: instrument_issuance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the issuance record.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Type (e.g., Card, Virtual Card, ACH Account, Token, Digital Wallet, Prepaid)
attributes.description: Categorises the kind of payment instrument being issued.

attributes.name: issuance_fee_amount

attributes.name: issuance_status_detail

attributes.name: issuance_timestamp

attributes.name: issuing_bank_code
attributes.description: Reference to the financial institution that issued the instrument.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Result of the Know‑Your‑Customer verification for the instrument holder.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total amount credited to the holder after deducting issuance fees.

attributes.name: net_currency
attributes.description: Currency of the net amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form field for operational comments or exceptions.

attributes.name: pan
attributes.description: The 16‑digit card number assigned to the issued card. Stored in encrypted form per PCI DSS.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal code representing the specific product variant (e.g., Visa Platinum, Debit‑Lite).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: token_service_provider_code

products.name: payment_txn
products.description: Core SSOT for every payment transaction processed through the platform — card-present, card-not-present, and digital payment channels. Captures the full ISO 8583 / ISO 20022 message lifecycle from authorization request through capture, including transaction amount, currency, MCC, channel type (POS, mPOS, eCommerce, QR, NFC, HCE), entry mode (EMV, swipe, contactless, manual), transaction timestamp, acquirer reference number (ARN), network transaction ID, processing code, response code, and STP flag. Single authoritative record per payment event.

attributes.name: payment_txn_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each payment transaction record.

attributes.name: account_holder_id
attributes.description: Internal surrogate key of the cardholder (or payer) involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_assessment. Business justification: Compliance audit mandates storing the detailed risk assessment record generated for each transaction, linking to risk.risk_assessment.

attributes.name: compliance_aml_screening_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_aml_screening_result. Business justification: Regulatory AML screening per transaction stores result in compliance_aml_screening_result; linking enables audit trails and SAR generation.

attributes.name: currency_pair_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fx.currency_pair. Business justification: Enables treasury to aggregate exposure and risk metrics by currency pair for each payment transaction.

attributes.name: device_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the device used to present the payment credential; may be a DPAN or device serial number.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wallet.digital_wallet. Business justification: Wallet‑originated payments must reference the originating digital wallet for reconciliation and AML reporting.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Internal surrogate key of the acquiring financial institution that processed the transaction.

attributes.name: gateway_api_credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gateway.api_credential. Business justification: Billing and security audits track which API credential (client) processed each payment transaction.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Internal surrogate key of the merchant that originated the transaction.

attributes.name: merchant_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchant.merchant_location. Business justification: Required for location‑level transaction reporting, risk scoring and settlement attribution; merchants need to know which physical location processed each payment.

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wallet.payment_instrument. Business justification: Required for settlement and instrument‑level reporting linking each payment transaction to the specific card or token used.

attributes.name: pos_entry_mode_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Txn Pos Entry Mode Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transaction.pos_entry_mode. Business justification: Standardize entry mode by linking payment_txn to the pos_entry_mode reference table; replace the free‑text entry_mode column with a foreign key.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the point‑of‑sale terminal that captured the transaction.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fx.fx_rate. Business justification: Required for audit and regulatory reporting to identify the exact FX rate applied to each cross‑border payment transaction.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Each transaction must be tagged with the applicable regulatory obligation (e.g., PSD2, AML) for reporting and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gateway.gateway_request. Business justification: Audit & compliance require linking each payment transaction to the originating API request for traceability and dispute investigation.

attributes.name: response_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gateway.gateway_response. Business justification: Reconciliation and settlement reports need the exact gateway response that settled the payment transaction.

attributes.name: risk_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_profile. Business justification: Regulatory AML/fraud monitoring requires each payment transaction to be linked to the associated risk profile used for scoring.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.scheme. Business justification: Regulatory interchange reporting requires each payment transaction to be linked to its card scheme for fee calculation and compliance.

attributes.name: sub_merchant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchant.sub_merchant. Business justification: Needed for PayFac models to attribute each payment to the originating sub‑merchant for settlement, revenue share, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Linking transaction currency to the currency master enables consistent currency handling and conversion logic. Add transaction_currency_id (FK to reference.currency.currency_id) and retire the free‑fo

attributes.name: transaction_mcc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.mcc. Business justification: Transaction records need a formal link to the MCC master data for reporting and fee calculation. Adding transaction_mcc_id (FK to reference.mcc.mcc_id) replaces the loosely‑typed mcc_code.

attributes.name: acquirer_code
attributes.description: Internal surrogate key of the acquiring financial institution that processed the transaction.

attributes.name: auth_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code generated by the issuer confirming approval of the transaction.

attributes.name: avs_result
attributes.description: Result code from AVS indicating match level between billing address and card issuer records.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch in which the transaction was processed for settlement.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Delivery channel through which the transaction was captured (POS, mPOS, eCommerce, QR, NFC, HCE, mobile_app, API).

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: True if the transaction passed all AML/KYC and regulatory screening checks.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was first persisted in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: cvv_result
attributes.description: Result code indicating whether the CVV supplied matched the issuer's record.

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Human‑readable reason provided when a transaction is declined (e.g., insufficient funds, suspected fraud).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate applied when the transaction involves a foreign currency.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Sum of fees (interchange, network, processing) applied to the transaction.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: True if the transaction was flagged for potential fraud and requires review.

attributes.name: is_cross_border
attributes.description: True if the transaction involved currency conversion or parties in different countries.

attributes.name: is_stp
attributes.description: True when the transaction was processed end‑to‑end without manual intervention.

attributes.name: iso_message_type
attributes.description: Four‑digit code identifying the message class (e.g., 0100 for authorization request).

attributes.name: iso_message_version
attributes.description: Year of the ISO 8583 version used for the message (e.g., 2003).

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Four‑digit code classifying the merchant's primary business activity.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final amount settled to the merchant after fees, expressed in transaction currency.

attributes.name: network
attributes.description: Card scheme or payment network that processed the transaction (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, UnionPay, Other).

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: Transaction amount in the original currency prior to conversion.

attributes.name: original_currency_code

attributes.name: payment_txn_status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the transaction (e.g., authorized, captured, settled, declined, reversed, chargeback).

attributes.name: processing_code
attributes.description: Four‑digit ISO 8583 processing code indicating transaction type and account handling.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk rating generated by the fraud engine; higher values indicate greater suspicion.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transaction was settled to the merchant's account.

attributes.name: settlement_instruction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to settlement.instruction. Business justification: Audit trail requires linking each payment transaction to its settlement instruction for regulatory reporting and dispute reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the settlement process (pending, settled, failed).

attributes.name: tokenization_flag
attributes.description: True if the transaction used a tokenized payment credential instead of a clear PAN.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the transaction before fees or adjustments, expressed in transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transaction Reference Number (ARN / Network Transaction ID)
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the acquiring network (e.g., Acquirer Reference Number) that uniquely identifies the transaction across the payment ecosystem.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date‑time when the transaction was initiated or authorized in the payment network.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the transaction (purchase, refund, reversal, cash_advance, preauth, capture).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this transaction record (e.g., status change, settlement update).

products.name: authorization
products.description: Real-time authorization decision record produced by the Payment Gateway and Authorization Engine for each payment transaction. Stores the authorization request and response pair including authorization code, response code, decline reason, AVS result, CVV result, 3DS authentication result, SCA outcome, issuer response time, network latency, and the final approve/decline/referral decision. One authorization record per authorization attempt; a single payment may have multiple authorization attempts (retries).

attributes.name: authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the authorization record.

attributes.name: authorization_response_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.authorization_response_code. Business justification: Compliance and fraud analysis need the exact authorization response code entity to interpret response meanings.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Card scheme lookup (Visa, MC, etc.) drives fee rules and risk scoring; linking to scheme master is required for accurate processing.

attributes.name: decline_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.decline_code. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires linking each authorization decline to the official decline_code reference for audit and analytics.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchant associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: original_auth_authorization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the first authorization attempt when this record is a retry.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the point‑of‑sale terminal or device used for the transaction.

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gateway.gateway_request. Business justification: Each authorization originates from a gateway API request; linking enables end‑to‑end audit of auth decisions.

attributes.name: amount_authorized

attributes.name: amount_requested
attributes.description: The monetary amount requested for authorization.

attributes.name: auth_reference_number

attributes.name: auth_retry_count

attributes.name: auth_source
attributes.description: Origin of the authorization request – real‑time or batch processing.

attributes.name: auth_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the authorization attempt.

attributes.name: authorization_code

attributes.name: avs_result
attributes.description: Result of the AVS check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Y|N|X|U|R|S|D|M|P|I|C|B|E|G|A|N — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: card_type

attributes.name: compliance_check_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction passed mandatory compliance checks (e.g., AML, sanctions).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this authorization record was first persisted.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction.

attributes.name: cvv_result
attributes.description: Result of the CVV check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: M|N|P|S|U|X — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Unique identifier derived from device characteristics for fraud detection.

attributes.name: device_ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device that originated the authorization request.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Categorical risk level derived from the fraud score.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score assigned by the fraud detection engine.

attributes.name: is_card_present

attributes.name: is_contactless

attributes.name: is_test_transaction

attributes.name: issuer_response_time_ms

attributes.name: merchant_category_code

attributes.name: merchant_country_code

products.name: capture
products.description: Capture record finalizing an authorized transaction for downstream clearing and settlement. Tracks the capture amount (which may differ from authorized amount for tip-adjusted or partial captures), capture timestamp, capture method (immediate, delayed, incremental), batch ID reference, and capture status. Represents the business event that moves a transaction from authorized to billable state in the Transaction Processing Platform.

products.description: Clearing file record generated by the Transaction Processing Platform representing a captured transaction submitted to the card scheme or ACH network for interbank settlement. SSOT for the clearing lifecycle stage of each transaction.

attributes.description: Globally unique identifier for the payment transaction across the SWIFT network.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment amount is to be settled.

products.name: txn_limit_rule
products.description: Business rule configuration defining transaction-level limits enforced during authorization — single transaction amount limits, daily cumulative limits, velocity limits (count per hour/day), card-present vs card-not-present limits, cross-border transaction limits, and contactless tap limits. Each rule stores the limit type, limit value, limit currency, applicable instrument type, applicable channel, effective date range, and the regulatory or risk basis for the limit (e.g., PSD2 contactless limit, scheme velocity rule). Owned by the transaction domain as these rules are enforced at authorization time.

attributes.name: txn_limit_rule_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the transaction limit rule.

attributes.name: txn_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transaction.txn_type. Business justification: Limit rules apply to specific transaction types; linking provides rule lookup based on type.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the transaction is initiated.

attributes.name: contactless_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount allowed for contactless (tap‑and‑go) transactions under this rule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount permitted for cross‑border transactions governed by this rule.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date on which the rule becomes active.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which the rule expires or is de‑activated (null if indefinite).

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument to which the rule applies.

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule overrides other applicable rules when conditions overlap.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value for the rule expressed in the limit currency.

attributes.name: limit_category
attributes.description: Classification of the rule type indicating which limit dimension it governs.

attributes.name: limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three‑letter currency code for the limit amount.

attributes.name: max_amount_per_day
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary limit for the total value of transactions in a single day.

attributes.name: max_amount_per_transaction
attributes.description: Upper bound on the monetary value of an individual transaction.

attributes.name: max_transactions_per_day
attributes.description: Velocity limit specifying the maximum number of transactions allowed in a calendar day.

attributes.name: max_transactions_per_hour
attributes.description: Velocity limit specifying the maximum number of transactions allowed in any rolling hour.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority used to resolve conflicts between multiple applicable rules (lower number = higher priority).

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory requirement (e.g., PSD2, PCI DSS) that drives the rule.

attributes.name: risk_basis
attributes.description: Explanation of the risk model or fraud scenario that justifies the rule.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code assigned to the rule for lookup and configuration management.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the rule used for display and reporting.

attributes.name: tap_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount for NFC tap transactions (often lower than standard contactless limit).

attributes.name: txn_limit_rule_description
attributes.description: Free‑form description of the business purpose and logic of the rule.

attributes.name: txn_limit_rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rule.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or process that last modified the rule.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the rule record.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the rule definition for change management.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or process that created the rule.

products.name: pos_entry_mode
products.description: Reference master of POS entry modes defining how payment credential data was captured at the point of interaction — EMV chip contact, EMV chip contactless (NFC), magnetic stripe, manual key entry, QR code scan, HCE, credential-on-file, and MOTO. Each entry mode record stores the ISO 8583 DE22 code, entry mode name, card-present indicator, authentication method, fallback eligibility, and chargeback liability rules applicable to that entry mode. Used to classify transactions for interchange qualification and fraud risk assessment.

attributes.name: pos_entry_mode_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each POS entry mode record. _canonical_skip_reason: Inferred role REFERENCE_LOOKUP, no minimum categories required.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Method used to authenticate the payment credential.

attributes.name: card_present_indicator
attributes.description: True when the card was physically present during the transaction.

attributes.name: chargeback_liability_rule
attributes.description: Rule that defines which party bears chargeback liability for this entry mode.

attributes.name: contactless_flag
attributes.description: True if the entry mode supports contactless (NFC) capture.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the entry mode record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credential_on_file_flag
attributes.description: True when the payment credential is stored for future recurring or tokenized transactions.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the entry mode definition becomes effective for processing.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the entry mode definition is retired or superseded (null if still active).

attributes.name: entry_mode_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the entry mode (e.g., "EMV Chip Contact", "Magnetic Stripe").

attributes.name: entry_mode_type
attributes.description: Categorized type of entry mode used at the point of interaction.

attributes.name: fallback_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entry mode can fall back to a lower‑security method if the primary method fails.

attributes.name: interchange_qualification_code
attributes.description: Code used by acquiring networks to qualify interchange rates for this entry mode.

attributes.name: iso_8583_de22_code
attributes.description: ISO 8583 field code that identifies the point-of-service entry mode used for the transaction.

attributes.name: moto_flag
attributes.description: True if the entry mode represents a MOTO transaction (card not present, entered manually).

attributes.name: pos_entry_mode_description
attributes.description: Free‑form description of the entry mode, including any special handling notes.

attributes.name: pos_entry_mode_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the entry mode definition.

attributes.name: qr_code_flag
attributes.description: True if the entry mode is QR code scan.

attributes.name: risk_score_average
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Risk Score for Entry Mode (AVG_RISK_SCORE)
attributes.description: Historical average fraud risk score associated with transactions using this entry mode.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the entry mode record.

products.name: transaction
products.description: Master reference table for transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for transaction

attributes.name: a2a_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.a2a_product. Business justification: Account‑to‑account transfers are governed by a2a product settings; linking enables settlement and compliance checks.

attributes.name: account_holder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the cardholder (or payer) involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Links transaction to its accounting period, required for period‑close, trial‑balance generation, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the processing batch that includes this transaction.

attributes.name: bnpl_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bnpl_plan. Business justification: BNPL purchases are tracked against a specific BNPL plan for installment schedules and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: card_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.card_program. Business justification: Card program analytics and spend‑control rules need the program identifier for every transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.cost_center. Business justification: Enables cost allocation per transaction for internal reporting and budgeting, used in expense tracking and cost‑center performance reports.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Currency master linkage is essential for settlement, FX conversion, and regulatory currency reporting.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the acquiring bank or payment processor.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Required for posting each transaction to the General Ledger revenue/expense account during journal entry creation, a core accounting process.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Associates each transaction with the owning legal entity for regulatory filing, consolidation, and entity‑level financial statements.

attributes.name: mcc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.mcc. Business justification: Linking transaction MCC to reference.mcc enables merchant category analytics and compliance with industry reporting.

attributes.name: merchant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchant.merchant_account. Business justification: Enables linking each transaction to the merchant’s settlement account used for funds transfer, essential for account‑level reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the merchant that originated the transaction.

attributes.name: p2p_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.p2p_product. Business justification: Peer‑to‑peer payments require linking each transaction to the P2P product definition for fee and risk rules.

attributes.name: payment_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.payment_product. Business justification: Required for product‑level reporting, fee calculation and compliance; each transaction must be tied to the specific payment product used.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the POS or ATM terminal used for the transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_response_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transaction.transaction_response_code. Business justification: Response code strings are normalized to transaction_response_code reference for consistency and reporting.

attributes.name: txn_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transaction.txn_channel. Business justification: Transaction records store channel as a string; linking to txn_channel provides a controlled list and eliminates redundancy.

attributes.name: txn_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transaction.txn_type. Business justification: Transaction type is currently a free‑text field; linking to txn_type enables standardized processing and rule enforcement.

attributes.name: virtual_account_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.virtual_account_product. Business justification: Virtual account usage must be recorded per transaction for balance control and regulatory audit.

attributes.name: wallet_device_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the end‑user device that originated the transaction.

attributes.name: aml_flag
attributes.description: True if the transaction passed AML screening.

attributes.name: amount_fee
attributes.description: Sum of all fees (interchange, network, service) applied to the transaction.

attributes.name: amount_gross
attributes.description: Total amount authorized before fees, taxes, or discounts.

attributes.name: amount_net
attributes.description: Final amount settled to the merchant after fees.

attributes.name: auth_code
attributes.description: Code returned by the issuer approving the transaction.

attributes.name: auth_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the authorization request was processed.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the authorized amount was captured.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction met all internal compliance checks.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transaction record was first created in the data lake.

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: True if the transaction involved parties in different countries.

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Human‑readable description of why the transaction was declined.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Currency conversion rate applied when transaction involves multiple currencies.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: True if the transaction was flagged as fraudulent.

attributes.name: is_card_present
attributes.description: True if the card was physically present at the point of sale.

attributes.name: is_contactless
attributes.description: True if the transaction used a contactless interface (NFC, tap).

attributes.name: issuing_institution_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the issuing bank or card scheme.

attributes.name: pan_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the Primary Account Number (masked for PCI compliance).

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Technical delivery channel for the payment request.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used to fund the transaction.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: External reference number (e.g., ARN, ISO 8583 Retrieval Reference Number) used to locate the transaction in downstream systems.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_indicator
attributes.description: True if the transaction must be reported to regulators (e.g., SAR, AML).

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when a reversal (void) was executed.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk assessment from the fraud detection platform.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transaction was settled with the acquiring bank.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the settlement process.

attributes.name: stp_indicator
attributes.description: True if the transaction was processed without manual intervention.

attributes.name: token_used
attributes.description: True if a token (DPAN) was used instead of the PAN.

attributes.name: tps
attributes.description: Observed TPS rate at the time of processing.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transaction event occurred (e.g., authorization request time).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the transaction record.

attributes.name: original_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on transaction (original_transaction_id)

domains.name: merchant
domains.description: SSOT for merchant identity, onboarding, and relationship management. Owns MID provisioning, MCC classification, merchant KYC/KYB verification, PayFac and ISO sub-merchant hierarchies, terminal registration, pricing configuration, settlement accounts, processing limits, and merchant lifecycle from application through offboarding.
domains.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, PCI DSS

products.name: merchant
products.description: Core master entity representing a merchant business entity onboarded to the payments platform. Owns the authoritative merchant identity record including legal business name, DBA name, MID (Merchant Identification Number), business registration details, tax identification, business type, incorporation country, operational status, and lifecycle stage from application through offboarding. SSOT for all merchant identity data.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant entity. Primary key. System-of-record identifier assigned during merchant onboarding and provisioning.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT: assigns a dedicated account‑manager employee to a merchant, required for relationship‑manager performance dashboards.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.cost_center. Business justification: Internal cost allocation and profitability analysis map each merchant to a cost center, supporting budgeting and expense tracking reports.

attributes.name: default_acquirer_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gateway.acquirer_endpoint. Business justification: Merchants select a primary acquirer endpoint for settlement; this FK drives settlement routing and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: default_interchange_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.interchange_program. Business justification: Merchants may enroll in specific interchange programs (e.g., debit or incentive programs); linking enables program eligibility reporting and rate application.

attributes.name: default_irf_rate_category_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Default Irf Rate Category Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.irf_rate_category. Business justification: Pricing engine needs a default IRF rate category per merchant to calculate fees; merchants are enrolled in a rate category for fee simulation and reporting.

attributes.name: default_scheme_fee_table_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Default Scheme Fee Table Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.scheme_fee_table. Business justification: Regulatory fee disclosure requires linking each merchant to the scheme fee table that defines applicable scheme fees for its transactions.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the ISO (Independent Sales Organization) partner responsible for merchant acquisition and relationship management. Null for direct merchants. Used for commission calculation and partner performance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO Agreement Terms, Partner Management Framework

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Regulatory consolidation requires each merchant to be linked to its legal entity for tax, KYC, and financial statement reporting.

attributes.name: mcc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.mcc. Business justification: Interchange risk and reporting require linking each merchant to the MCC reference for accurate fee and compliance calculations.

attributes.name: merchant_reserve_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchant.reserve_account. Business justification: Merchant may have a rolling reserve account; linking merchant to reserve_account centralizes reserve data and removes duplicated reserve fields from merchant.

attributes.name: participant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to settlement.participant. Business justification: Required for participant onboarding and daily settlement reporting; each merchant must be linked to a settlement participant for AML/KYC and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: payfac_parent_merchant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent Payment Facilitator (PayFac) merchant if this merchant is a sub-merchant operating under a PayFac model. Null for direct merchants and top-level PayFacs. Used for hierarchical reporting and liability management.
attributes.references: PayFac Registration Requirements, Card Scheme PayFac Rules

attributes.name: primary_account_holder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cardholder.account_holder. Business justification: Required for corporate settlement reporting: merchant must reference its primary account holder (owner) to allocate fees and generate compliance reports.

attributes.name: processing_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Settlement and FX processing depend on the merchant's processing currency, which must reference the master currency list for conversion rates and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gateway.gateway_region. Business justification: Regulatory and data‑residency rules require each merchant to be associated with a processing region.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Merchant onboarding assigns regulatory obligations (e.g., AML, PSD2) to each merchant; linking supports obligation tracking, reporting, and ongoing compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: revenue_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue from merchant transactions must be posted to a specific GL account; linking enables automated journal entry generation for compliance and audit.

attributes.name: routing_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_endpoint. Business justification: Required for assigning a specific network endpoint for transaction routing during merchant onboarding, enabling routing decisions per merchant.

attributes.name: underwriting_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.underwriting_policy. Business justification: Every merchant is assigned an underwriting policy that defines risk limits; this link supports policy enforcement and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date when the merchant was activated for live transaction processing. May differ from onboarding_date if there is a testing or approval period. Marks the start of revenue-generating activity.
attributes.references: Merchant Agreement Terms, Service Level Agreement (SLA)

attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the merchant's registered business address (street number and name). Used for KYB verification, regulatory reporting, and correspondence. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: business_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the merchant's registered business address (suite, floor, building name). Optional field. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: business_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality of the merchant's registered business address. Used for geographic analysis, tax jurisdiction determination, and regulatory reporting. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: business_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the merchant's registered business address. Used for sanctions screening, cross-border rules, and regulatory reporting. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: business_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the merchant's registered business address. Used for address verification, tax calculation, and geographic analysis. Format varies by country. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union Standards, Address Verification System (AVS)

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: The official business registration or company number issued by the government authority in the incorporation jurisdiction. Used for KYB (Know Your Business) verification and legal entity validation.
attributes.references: KYB Standards, Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Framework

attributes.name: business_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region of the merchant's registered business address. Used for tax jurisdiction, regulatory compliance, and geographic segmentation. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: KYB Standards, State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: business_type
attributes.description: The legal structure and classification of the merchant business entity. Determines regulatory requirements, tax treatment, and liability structure.

attributes.name: chargeback_threshold_count
attributes.description: The maximum number of chargebacks allowed per month before the merchant is flagged for review or placed in a monitoring program. Exceeding this threshold may result in increased reserves, fines, or termination.
attributes.references: Visa Chargeback Monitoring Program (VCMP), Mastercard Excessive Chargeback Program (ECP)

attributes.name: chargeback_threshold_ratio
attributes.description: The maximum allowed chargeback ratio (chargebacks divided by total transactions) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0100 for 1.00%). Exceeding this threshold triggers card scheme monitoring programs and potential penalties.
attributes.references: Visa Chargeback Monitoring Program (VCMP), Mastercard Excessive Chargeback Program (ECP)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this merchant record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record retention compliance. Immutable after initial creation.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or DBA (Doing Business As) name under which the merchant operates and is publicly known. May differ from legal business name. Displayed on cardholder statements.
attributes.references: Card Scheme Rules - Merchant Descriptor Requirements

attributes.name: incorporation_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the merchant business is legally incorporated or registered. Used for regulatory compliance, sanctions screening, and cross-border payment rules.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, FATF Country Risk Assessment

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when KYC/KYB verification was successfully completed for the merchant. Used for compliance audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the KYC/KYB (Know Your Business) verification process for the merchant. Indicates whether identity verification, business documentation, and beneficial ownership checks have been completed and approved.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10, BSA/AML Requirements, PSD2 Article 4

attributes.name: legal_business_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the merchant business entity as recorded in incorporation or business registration documents. Used for regulatory reporting, compliance verification, and legal contracts.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the merchant in the payment platform lifecycle. Governs transaction processing eligibility, settlement, and platform access. Transitions managed through merchant lifecycle workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: application|pending_review|approved|active|suspended|terminated|offboarded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Merchant Lifecycle Management Framework, PCI DSS Requirement 12.8

attributes.name: mdr_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate charged to the merchant for payment processing services, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0275 for 2.75%). Represents the merchant's cost of acceptance. Varies by card type, transaction type, and merchant volume tier.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement, Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) Framework

attributes.name: mid
attributes.description: The externally-known unique Merchant Identification Number (MID) assigned by the acquiring bank or payment processor. Used for transaction routing, authorization, settlement, and reporting. Distinct from internal merchant_id surrogate key.

attributes.name: monthly_processing_limit
attributes.description: The maximum total payment volume (in processing currency) that the merchant is authorized to process per calendar month. Used for risk management and fraud prevention. Exceeding this limit may trigger holds or additional review.
attributes.references: Risk Management Policy, Merchant Agreement Terms

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: The date when the merchant was successfully onboarded to the payment platform and assigned a MID. Marks the start of the merchant relationship and eligibility for transaction processing.
attributes.references: Merchant Agreement Terms, Regulatory Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: operating_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country where the merchant conducts business operations. May differ from incorporation country for multinational merchants.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary business contact for the merchant account. Used for operational notifications, settlement reports, dispute alerts, and compliance communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the primary business contact person for the merchant account. Used for operational communication, support escalation, and account management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Merchant Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary business contact for the merchant account. Used for urgent operational communication, fraud alerts, and account verification. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The risk classification assigned to the merchant based on MCC, transaction patterns, chargeback history, geographic location, and business model. Determines monitoring intensity, reserve requirements, and processing limits.
attributes.references: Card Scheme Risk Management Programs, MATCH List, TMF

attributes.name: settlement_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number where merchant settlement funds are deposited. Encrypted at rest. Used for ACH, wire transfer, or RTGS settlement processing. Format varies by country and payment rail.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3, NACHA Operating Rules, SEPA Scheme Rulebook

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which settled funds are transferred to the merchant's bank account. Configured based on merchant agreement, risk profile, and processing volume.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement, Settlement Processing Standards

attributes.name: settlement_routing_number
attributes.description: The bank routing number, sort code, or SWIFT/BIC code for the merchant's settlement account. Used to route settlement funds to the correct financial institution. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., ABA routing number in USA, sort code in UK, SWIFT BIC internationally).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, SWIFT Standards, IBAN Registry

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The government-issued tax identification number for the merchant business entity. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in India). Used for tax reporting, regulatory compliance, and identity verification.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179, OECD Common Reporting Standard

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the merchant relationship was terminated and the merchant was offboarded from the payment platform. Nullable for active merchants. Used for retention analysis and regulatory record-keeping.
attributes.references: Merchant Agreement Termination Clause, Record Retention Policy

attributes.name: transaction_limit_single
attributes.description: The maximum amount (in processing currency) allowed for a single transaction. Transactions exceeding this limit are declined at authorization. Set based on merchant risk profile and business model.
attributes.references: Risk Management Policy, Authorization Rules Engine

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this merchant record was last modified. Updated automatically on any field change. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The primary website URL of the merchant business. Used for business verification, fraud screening, and customer service reference. Required for e-commerce merchants.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 6.6, Merchant Verification Standards

products.name: application
products.description: Captures the full merchant onboarding application lifecycle — from initial submission through underwriting review, KYC/KYB verification, and final approval or rejection. Tracks application type (new, change, reinstatement), submission channel, assigned underwriter, decision rationale, required documentation checklist, and timestamps for each stage. Source of record for the Merchant Management System onboarding workflow.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant application record. Primary key for the merchant application entity.

attributes.name: assigned_underwriter_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underwriting analyst assigned to review this merchant application. Used for workload distribution and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the ISO partner who referred or manages this merchant relationship. Used for commission calculation and relationship management.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underwriting analyst assigned to review this merchant application. Used for workload distribution and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent Payment Facilitator if this is a sub-merchant application. Establishes hierarchical relationship for settlement and liability.

attributes.name: parent_payfac_merchant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent Payment Facilitator if this is a sub-merchant application. Establishes hierarchical relationship for settlement and liability.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique application reference number assigned at submission. Used for tracking and customer communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the merchant application. Tracks progression from initial draft through underwriting review to final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|pending_documentation|approved|rejected|withdrawn|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Classification of the application purpose: new merchant onboarding, change to existing merchant profile, reinstatement after termination, upgrade or downgrade of service tier, or reactivation of dormant account.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for merchant settlement deposits. Used for ACH credit transfers of processed transaction funds. Subject to account verification before approval.

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account designated for settlement. Determines ACH transaction codes and processing rules.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number for the merchant's settlement bank. Used for ACH settlement processing and account verification.

attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the merchant's principal place of business. Used for KYB verification and AVS validation.

attributes.name: business_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, unit, or building information. Optional field for complete business address.

attributes.name: business_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the merchant's principal place of business.

attributes.name: business_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the merchant's principal place of business. Used for cross-border risk assessment and sanctions screening.

attributes.name: business_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the merchant's business model, products sold, services offered, and target customer base. Used by underwriters to assess risk and validate MCC classification.

attributes.name: business_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the merchant's business address. Used for AVS verification and geographic risk assessment.

attributes.name: business_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the merchant's business address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: business_type
attributes.description: Legal structure of the merchant entity. Determines underwriting requirements, liability assessment, and documentation checklist.

attributes.name: business_website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the merchant's business. Used for business verification, fraud screening, and brand reputation assessment.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact. Used for application status notifications and ongoing merchant communication.

attributes.name: contact_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the primary business contact or authorized representative for the merchant application.

attributes.name: contact_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the primary business contact or authorized representative for the merchant application.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the business contact. Used for verification calls and urgent communication during underwriting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the merchant application record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_check_performed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit bureau check was performed on the business owner. Required for most merchant applications per underwriting policy.

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Personal credit score of the principal business owner obtained from credit bureau. Used for creditworthiness assessment and pricing determination.

attributes.name: decision_code
attributes.description: Final underwriting decision outcome. Determines next steps in merchant onboarding workflow and triggers downstream provisioning or notification processes.

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the underwriting decision including risk factors considered, policy violations identified, or conditions imposed. Used for adverse action notices and audit trail.
attributes.references: FCRA, ECOA, Merchant Management System Standard

attributes.name: documentation_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required documentation has been received and validated. Gates progression to final approval stage.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the merchant operates. May differ from legal name and appears on customer-facing materials.

attributes.name: estimated_average_ticket
attributes.description: Projected average transaction amount in base currency. Used for fraud risk modeling and chargeback exposure assessment.

attributes.name: estimated_monthly_volume
attributes.description: Merchant's projected monthly payment processing volume in base currency. Used for risk assessment, pricing tier determination, and reserve calculation.

attributes.name: kyb_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of KYB business entity verification including legal registration, business license, and beneficial ownership validation. Required for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, BSA, FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of KYC identity verification process for business owners and authorized signers. Must pass before final approval per AML regulations.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, BSA, FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the merchant application record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: legal_business_name
attributes.description: Official registered legal name of the merchant entity as it appears on incorporation documents. Used for KYB (Know Your Business) verification and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: ofac_screening_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screening Status
attributes.description: Result of OFAC sanctions list screening for business entity and principals. Must be clear before approval to comply with US sanctions regulations.

attributes.name: owner_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the principal business owner. Used for identity verification and age validation during KYC process.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, BSA, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: owner_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the principal business owner or majority stakeholder. Required for KYC verification and beneficial ownership identification per FinCEN rules.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, BSA, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: owner_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the principal business owner or majority stakeholder. Required for KYC verification and beneficial ownership identification per FinCEN rules.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, BSA, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: owner_ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number of the principal business owner. Required for personal credit check, identity verification, and OFAC screening during underwriting.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, BSA, OFAC, FCRA

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of business ownership held by the principal owner. Used to determine beneficial ownership reporting requirements per FinCEN 25% threshold rule.

attributes.name: payfac_sub_merchant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application is for a sub-merchant under a Payment Facilitator model. Determines underwriting requirements and settlement hierarchy.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, Payment Facilitator Standards

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: Source of the merchant application referral (e.g., direct, partner, web, sales_rep). Used for marketing attribution and channel performance analysis.

attributes.name: requested_mcc
attributes.description: Four-digit MCC code requested by the merchant that classifies their business type. Subject to underwriter validation and may be adjusted based on actual business model. Determines interchange rates and risk profile.
attributes.references: ISO 18245, Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: requested_processing_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment processing methods requested by merchant (e.g., card_present, card_not_present, ecommerce, moto, recurring). Determines equipment needs and risk profile.

attributes.name: required_documentation_checklist
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required documents for application completion (e.g., articles_of_incorporation, bank_statement, voided_check, government_id). Varies by business type and risk profile.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk assessment score assigned during underwriting. Combines credit risk, fraud risk, and business risk factors. Used for pricing tier assignment and reserve determination.

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the merchant application was submitted. Used for channel performance analysis and fraud pattern detection.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the merchant application was formally submitted for underwriting review. Represents the business event timestamp for SLA tracking.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number (EIN for businesses, SSN for sole proprietors). Used for IRS reporting, KYB verification, and OFAC screening.

attributes.name: underwriting_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when underwriting review was completed and final decision was rendered. Used for SLA compliance reporting and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: underwriting_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the application entered underwriting review. Used for SLA tracking and process efficiency measurement.

products.name: merchant_location
products.description: Represents a physical or virtual merchant outlet location associated with a merchant entity. Stores location name, address (street, city, state, postal code, country), location type (physical storefront, kiosk, online, mPOS), operating hours, geo-coordinates, timezone, and location-level MCC override. A single merchant may operate multiple locations each with independent settlement and terminal configurations.

attributes.name: merchant_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant location. Primary key.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Merchant location needs a proper link to the country master to support geo‑analytics and compliance checks. Add location_country_id (FK to reference.country.country_id) and retire the raw country_code

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent merchant entity that owns this location.

attributes.name: merchant_settlement_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement account where funds for transactions at this location are deposited.

attributes.name: processing_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Location‑specific processing may use a different currency; linking to the currency reference supports localized settlement rules.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when this location was activated and began processing live transactions.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the merchant location (street number, street name, suite/unit).

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details (building, floor, department).

attributes.name: chargeback_threshold_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of chargebacks allowed per monitoring period before triggering compliance review or location suspension.

attributes.name: chargeback_threshold_ratio
attributes.description: Maximum chargeback-to-transaction ratio allowed (e.g., 0.0090 for 0.9%) before triggering compliance action per card scheme rules.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the merchant location is situated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this merchant location record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_transaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total transaction volume allowed per day for this location, used for risk management and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or 'Doing Business As' name under which this location operates, if different from the legal merchant name.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when this location was deactivated or closed, ceasing transaction processing.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for location-specific communications and notifications.

attributes.name: fraud_monitoring_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time fraud detection and prevention monitoring is enabled for transactions at this location.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when KYC/KYB verification was completed for this location.
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) BSA Requirements

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of Know Your Customer (KYC) and Know Your Business (KYB) verification for this location: verified, pending review, failed verification, or expired requiring re-verification.
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) BSA Requirements

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction processed at this location, used for dormancy monitoring and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the merchant location in decimal degrees for mapping and proximity analytics.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Business name or identifier for this specific merchant location (e.g., 'Downtown Store', 'Airport Terminal 3').

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the merchant location in its lifecycle: active (processing transactions), inactive (temporarily not processing), suspended (compliance hold), pending (onboarding), or closed (permanently offboarded).

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the merchant location type: physical storefront, kiosk, online, mobile Point of Sale (mPOS), virtual, or pop-up.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the merchant location in decimal degrees for mapping and proximity analytics.

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Four-digit Merchant Category Code (MCC) classification for this location, which may override the parent merchant MCC for location-specific business activities.

attributes.name: mid
attributes.description: Unique Merchant Identification Number (MID) assigned to this location by the acquiring bank or payment processor for transaction routing and settlement.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when this merchant location was successfully onboarded and provisioned in the payment processing system.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the location (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM, Sat 10AM-2PM') used for customer service and transaction pattern analysis.

attributes.name: pci_attestation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Attestation Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent PCI DSS compliance attestation or Self-Assessment Questionnaire (SAQ) completion for this location.
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council PCI DSS

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliance Level
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliance level assigned to this location based on annual transaction volume: Level 1 (>6M), Level 2 (1M-6M), Level 3 (20K-1M), Level 4 (<20K).
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council PCI DSS

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the merchant location.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the merchant location address.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Current risk assessment score for this location (0-100 scale) based on transaction patterns, chargeback history, fraud indicators, and compliance factors.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk classification tier for this location: low, medium, high, or critical, determining monitoring intensity and processing controls.

attributes.name: single_transaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount allowed for a single transaction at this location, enforced during authorization.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the merchant location.

attributes.name: three_ds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether 3-D Secure (3DS) authentication is mandatory for card-not-present transactions at this location, per PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) or merchant policy.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the merchant location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London) used for transaction timestamp normalization.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this merchant location record was last modified.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Website URL specific to this merchant location, if applicable (e.g., location-specific landing page).

products.name: merchant_contact
products.description: Stores named contacts associated with a merchant entity — including primary business contact, billing contact, technical integration contact, and dispute contact. Captures full name, title, role type, email, phone, preferred communication channel, and contact status. Supports multi-contact management per merchant for relationship and operational communications.

attributes.name: merchant_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant entity this contact is associated with. Links contact to the parent merchant record for relationship management.

attributes.name: can_receive_dispute_notifications
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should receive chargeback and dispute notifications. Enables targeted communication for time-sensitive dispute response requirements.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, Dispute Management Best Practices

attributes.name: can_receive_pci_data
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is authorized to receive communications containing Payment Card Industry (PCI) sensitive data. Ensures PCI DSS compliance in data transmission.

attributes.name: can_receive_settlement_reports
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should receive settlement and funding reports. Used for financial reconciliation and treasury management communications.
attributes.references: ERP - Oracle Financials, Settlement Best Practices

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the merchant contact record. Determines whether the contact should receive communications and appear in active contact lists.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact role within the merchant organization. Determines the purpose and scope of communication with this contact.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this contact record. Supports audit trail and accountability for data governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Business unit or department within the merchant organization where the contact works. Used for routing communications to appropriate functional areas.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact record became active and valid for the merchant relationship. Supports temporal tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact record ceased to be active for the merchant relationship. Null for currently active contacts. Supports historical tracking and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic communication with the merchant contact. Used for transaction notifications, dispute correspondence, and operational alerts.

attributes.name: email_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of marketing or non-essential email communications. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Facsimile number for document transmission. Used for formal dispute documentation and regulatory correspondence requiring written records.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the merchant contact person. Used for personalized communication and identification.

attributes.name: is_authorized_signer
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has legal authority to sign contracts and agreements on behalf of the merchant. Critical for KYC and contract execution workflows.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the merchant. Used to prioritize communication routing and escalation paths.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Professional title or position of the contact within the merchant organization. Indicates authority level and functional responsibility.

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
