attributes.description: Date when the current KYC verification expires and re-verification is required. Supports periodic review requirements under AML and CTF regulations.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when KYC verification was completed for this contact. Used to track verification currency and trigger re-verification workflows per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identity verification and KYC checks for this contact. Required for compliance with AML and CTF regulations for authorized signers and key contacts.
attributes.references: KYC Standards, AML Regulations, BSA, FATF

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent communication or interaction with this contact. Used for relationship management and contact data quality maintenance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this contact record. Supports audit trail and accountability for data changes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this contact record. Critical for change tracking, audit trails, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the merchant contact person. Used for formal identification and communication.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the merchant contact person. Optional field for complete name representation.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile or cellular phone number for SMS notifications and mobile communication. Used for time-sensitive alerts and two-factor authentication.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special instructions, or relationship notes about the contact. Supports relationship management and customer service quality.

attributes.name: phone_extension
attributes.description: Internal extension number for direct routing within the merchant organization phone system. Enables direct contact bypass of main switchboard.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for voice communication with the merchant contact. Used for urgent matters, dispute resolution, and relationship management.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: Contact's preferred method for receiving communications from the payment processor. Ensures compliance with communication preferences and improves response rates.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21, CCPA, CRM Best Practices

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code indicating the contact's preferred language for communication. Supports multilingual merchant base and regulatory compliance in international markets.

attributes.name: secondary_email_address
attributes.description: Alternate email address for backup communication. Used when primary email is unavailable or for redundant critical notifications.

attributes.name: sms_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of SMS or text message communications. Required for compliance with telecommunications regulations and privacy laws.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this contact record. Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system integration scenarios.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework, ETL Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this contact in the source operational system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and bidirectional data synchronization.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework, ETL Best Practices

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for the current contact status. Provides audit trail for status changes and supports compliance documentation.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contact's location. Used for scheduling communications during business hours and timestamping interactions appropriately.

products.name: kyb_verification
products.description: Records the Know Your Business (KYB) verification outcome for a merchant entity. Captures verification provider, verification date, business identity check result, UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Owner) screening result, sanctions/OFAC screening result, adverse media check, document verification status, risk tier assigned, and overall KYB pass/fail decision. Supports AML and regulatory compliance requirements for merchant onboarding.
products.reference: KYC/KYB - Know Your Customer / Know Your Business

attributes.name: kyb_verification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the KYB verification record. Primary key for the KYB verification entity.

attributes.name: compliance_kyc_verification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_kyc_verification. Business justification: KYB verification results are derived from detailed compliance KYC verification records; linking provides traceability for regulatory audits and risk assessments.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance officer or user who performed manual review of the KYB verification results.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant entity undergoing KYB verification. Links this verification to the merchant master record.

attributes.name: reviewer_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance officer or user who performed manual review of the KYB verification results.

attributes.name: adverse_media_check_result
attributes.description: Outcome of adverse media screening to identify negative news, criminal activity, fraud, or reputational risks associated with the business entity.

attributes.name: aml_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of Anti-Money Laundering screening checks to identify potential money laundering risks or suspicious activity patterns.

attributes.name: business_identity_check_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the business entity identity verification check confirming legal existence, registration status, and business name match against official registries.

attributes.name: business_legal_name
attributes.description: Verified legal name of the business entity as registered with government authorities and confirmed during KYB verification.

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: Official government-issued business registration or incorporation number verified during the KYB process (e.g., EIN, Company Registration Number).

attributes.name: business_type
attributes.description: Legal structure type of the business entity verified during KYB (e.g., corporation, limited liability company, partnership, sole proprietorship).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the KYB verification record was first created in the system, marking the initiation of the verification process.

attributes.name: ctf_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of Counter-Terrorism Financing screening checks to identify potential terrorism financing risks or connections to terrorist organizations.

attributes.name: data_sources_used
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of data sources and registries consulted during KYB verification (e.g., Companies House, Dun & Bradstreet, OFAC SDN, Dow Jones Watchlist).

attributes.name: document_types_verified
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of document types that were verified during the KYB process (e.g., articles of incorporation, business license, tax ID certificate, bank statement).

attributes.name: document_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of business document verification including articles of incorporation, business licenses, tax certificates, and other supporting documentation.

attributes.name: incorporation_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the business entity is legally incorporated or registered.

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: Date when the business entity was officially incorporated or registered as verified during KYB checks.

attributes.name: manual_review_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why manual compliance review is required, detailing specific alerts, inconclusive checks, or policy triggers.

attributes.name: manual_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the KYB verification results require manual review by compliance officers due to inconclusive results, risk alerts, or policy exceptions.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYB re-verification or refresh based on risk tier and regulatory requirements for ongoing due diligence.

attributes.name: ofac_screening_result
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screening Result
attributes.description: Specific outcome of screening against the US Office of Foreign Assets Control Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List.

attributes.name: overall_kyb_decision
attributes.description: Final pass or fail decision for the KYB verification determining whether the merchant is approved for onboarding, rejected, conditionally approved, or requires manual review.

attributes.name: pep_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of screening to identify if the business or its beneficial owners are politically exposed persons requiring enhanced due diligence.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the KYB verification was rejected or failed, including specific check failures and compliance concerns.

attributes.name: review_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when manual compliance review of the KYB verification was completed and final decision was rendered.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Internal compliance notes and comments recorded by the reviewer during manual review of the KYB verification, documenting decision rationale.

attributes.name: risk_factors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific risk factors identified during KYB verification (e.g., high-risk MCC, high-risk jurisdiction, adverse media, PEP association).

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score calculated by the verification provider based on all KYB checks, typically ranging from 0 to 100 with higher scores indicating greater risk.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk classification tier assigned to the merchant based on KYB verification results, determining the level of ongoing monitoring and due diligence required.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of sanctions and watchlist screening against OFAC, UN, EU, and other global sanctions lists to identify prohibited business relationships.

attributes.name: ubo_count
attributes.description: Number of Ultimate Beneficial Owners identified and verified during the KYB process who meet the ownership or control threshold.

attributes.name: ubo_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the Ultimate Beneficial Owner screening check verifying individuals who own or control 25% or more of the business entity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the KYB verification record was last modified, tracking changes to verification status, results, or review outcomes.

attributes.name: verification_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cost charged by the verification provider for performing the KYB verification checks, used for cost tracking and merchant billing.

attributes.name: verification_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the verification cost amount.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the KYB verification was performed and results were received from the verification provider.

attributes.name: verification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current KYB verification expires and requires renewal to maintain merchant compliance status.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the KYB verification indicating whether checks were fully automated, manual, or a hybrid combination.

attributes.name: verification_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party KYB verification service provider that performed the business identity and compliance checks (e.g., Refinitiv, LexisNexis, Dow Jones).

attributes.name: verification_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the verification provider for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KYB verification process indicating whether checks are pending, in progress, completed successfully, failed, expired, or require manual review.

products.name: beneficial_owner
products.description: Captures the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) records for a merchant entity as required by BSA/AML regulations. Stores owner full name, date of birth, nationality, government ID type and number, ownership percentage, control role (director, officer, shareholder), PEP (Politically Exposed Person) flag, sanctions screening status, and identity verification outcome. Regulatory requirement for FinCEN CDD Rule compliance.
products.reference: FinCEN CDD Rule - Customer Due Diligence

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the beneficial owner record. Primary key for the beneficial owner entity.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant entity for which this beneficial owner record applies. Links the UBO to the merchant undergoing KYC/KYB verification.

attributes.name: adverse_media_screening_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the most recent adverse media screening was performed on the beneficial owner.

attributes.name: adverse_media_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of adverse media screening to identify negative news or reputational risks associated with the beneficial owner. Part of enhanced due diligence process.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12, Enhanced Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall AML risk rating assigned to the beneficial owner based on risk factors including PEP status, sanctions screening, country risk, and ownership structure.

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the beneficial owner record. Indicates whether the record is active, under review, or has been rejected due to compliance issues.

attributes.name: control_role
attributes.description: Role or position held by the beneficial owner that grants significant control over the merchant entity. Required for FinCEN CDD Rule compliance to identify individuals with control authority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: director|officer|shareholder|trustee|beneficiary|authorized_signatory|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_role_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the beneficial owner's control role and responsibilities within the merchant entity. Provides context for the nature of control exercised.

attributes.name: country_of_residence
attributes.description: Country where the beneficial owner currently resides using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Used for tax reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the beneficial owner record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the beneficial owner in yyyy-MM-dd format. Required for identity verification, age validation, and AML screening under FinCEN CDD Rule.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the beneficial owner relationship with the merchant entity became effective. Used for temporal tracking of ownership changes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the beneficial owner relationship with the merchant entity ended. Null for currently active beneficial owners.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name or first name of the beneficial owner. Used for identity verification and screening purposes.

attributes.name: full_legal_name
attributes.description: Complete legal name of the beneficial owner as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Required for BSA/AML compliance and identity verification.

attributes.name: government_id_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the government-issued identification document. Used to ensure validity of identity verification.

attributes.name: government_id_issuing_country
attributes.description: Country that issued the government identification document using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: government_id_number
attributes.description: Unique identification number from the government-issued document. Encrypted at rest and used for identity verification and AML screening.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule 31 CFR 1010.230, PCI DSS

attributes.name: government_id_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identification document provided by the beneficial owner for identity verification. Required under FinCEN CDD Rule.

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the beneficial owner's identity was successfully verified. Required for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the identity of the beneficial owner. Supports multiple verification channels to meet regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: identity_verification_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party service or internal system used to perform identity verification. Used for audit trail and vendor management.

attributes.name: identity_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the identity verification process for the beneficial owner. Indicates whether identity has been successfully verified, is pending review, or has failed verification checks.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, KYC Best Practices

attributes.name: is_pep
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficial owner is a Politically Exposed Person. PEPs require enhanced due diligence under FATF recommendations and AML regulations.

attributes.name: kyc_refresh_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Refresh Due Date
attributes.description: Date when the beneficial owner KYC information is due for periodic refresh and re-verification. Required for ongoing due diligence under AML regulations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10, FinCEN Guidance on Ongoing Due Diligence

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Surname or family name of the beneficial owner. Required for identity verification and AML screening.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the beneficial owner. Optional field for enhanced identity matching.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: Country of citizenship of the beneficial owner using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Required for sanctions screening and cross-border compliance.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership stake held by the beneficial owner in the merchant entity. FinCEN CDD Rule requires disclosure for owners with 25% or more equity interest.

attributes.name: pep_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the PEP status indicating whether the individual is a domestic PEP, foreign PEP, member of international organization, family member, or close associate of a PEP.

attributes.name: pep_position_title
attributes.description: Title or position held by the beneficial owner that qualifies them as a PEP. Examples include government official, senior executive of state-owned enterprise, or high-ranking military officer.

attributes.name: residential_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the beneficial owner's residential address. Required for identity verification and KYC compliance.

attributes.name: residential_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number of the beneficial owner's residential address.

attributes.name: residential_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the beneficial owner's residential address.

attributes.name: residential_country
attributes.description: Country of the beneficial owner's residential address using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: residential_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the beneficial owner's residential address.

attributes.name: residential_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the beneficial owner's residential address.

attributes.name: sanctions_match_details
attributes.description: Details of any sanctions list matches including list name, match score, and reason for match. Used for investigation and resolution of potential sanctions violations.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the most recent sanctions screening was performed on the beneficial owner. Required for audit trail and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of sanctions screening against OFAC, UN, EU, and other sanctions lists. Indicates whether the beneficial owner is clear, has a match, or requires further review.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Chapter V, UN Security Council Sanctions, EU Sanctions

attributes.name: source_of_funds
attributes.description: Description of the origin of funds used by the beneficial owner in the merchant relationship. Required for enhanced due diligence and AML compliance.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12, Enhanced Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: source_of_wealth
attributes.description: Description of how the beneficial owner accumulated their wealth. Required for enhanced due diligence on high-risk individuals and PEPs.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12, Enhanced Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the beneficial owner record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: merchant_account
products.description: Represents the processing account configuration for a merchant — the operational account that governs transaction processing parameters. Stores account status, processing currency, accepted card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), enabled payment methods, 3DS configuration, SCA requirements, AVS/CVV policy settings, transaction velocity limits, and account-level risk controls. Distinct from the merchant settlement bank account.

attributes.name: merchant_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant processing account. Primary key.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent merchant entity that owns this processing account.

attributes.name: processing_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Each account may operate in a specific currency; linking to the currency reference enables correct fee schedules and cross‑border rules.

attributes.name: reserve_account_id
attributes.description: FK to settlement.reserve_account.reserve_account_id — MUST-HAVE: After removing merchant.reserve_account (SSOT violation), merchant.merchant_account needs FK to settlement.reserve_account to maintain the merchant-reserve relationship. Enables merchant re

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number assigned to this processing account for identification in statements and reports.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the merchant processing account. Active accounts can process transactions; suspended/restricted accounts have limited processing; closed accounts are terminated.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the processing account model: standard merchant account, Payment Facilitator (PayFac) sub-merchant account, Independent Sales Organization (ISO) account, aggregator account, marketplace account, or direct acquiring account.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the merchant account was activated and became eligible to process transactions.

attributes.name: avs_check_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Address Verification System checks are enabled for card-not-present transactions to validate cardholder billing address.

attributes.name: batch_settlement_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses batch settlement processing where transactions are grouped and settled in scheduled batches rather than real-time settlement.

attributes.name: card_not_present_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is authorized to process card-not-present transactions such as e-commerce, mail order, or telephone order (MOTO) payments.

attributes.name: card_present_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is authorized to process card-present transactions via Point of Sale (POS) or mobile Point of Sale (mPOS) terminals.

attributes.name: chargeback_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable chargeback ratio (chargebacks divided by total transactions) expressed as a percentage. Exceeding this threshold may trigger account review or restrictions per card scheme monitoring programs.
attributes.references: Visa Dispute Monitoring Program, Mastercard Excessive Chargeback Program

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the merchant account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this merchant account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_processing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is authorized to process cross-border transactions where the cardholder and merchant are in different countries.

attributes.name: cvv_check_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Card Verification Value (CVV/CVV2/CVC) validation is enabled for card-not-present transactions to verify card possession.

attributes.name: daily_transaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total transaction volume (in processing currency) that this account is permitted to process within a single calendar day. Used for risk management and velocity controls.

attributes.name: dynamic_currency_conversion_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enabled for Dynamic Currency Conversion, allowing cardholders to see and pay in their home currency at the point of sale.

attributes.name: enhanced_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to enhanced transaction monitoring due to elevated risk profile, regulatory requirements, or past compliance issues.

attributes.name: fraud_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable fraud ratio (fraudulent transactions divided by total transactions) expressed as a percentage. Exceeding this threshold may trigger enhanced fraud controls or account restrictions.
attributes.references: Visa Fraud Monitoring Program, Mastercard Fraud Monitoring Program

attributes.name: installment_payment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account supports installment payment plans where a single purchase is split into multiple scheduled payments.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this merchant account record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction processed through this merchant account. Used for account activity monitoring and dormancy detection.

attributes.name: monthly_transaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total transaction volume (in processing currency) that this account is permitted to process within a single calendar month. Used for risk management and underwriting controls.

attributes.name: multi_currency_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is configured to accept and process transactions in multiple currencies beyond the primary processing currency.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliance Level
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliance validation level assigned to this merchant account based on annual transaction volume: Level 1 (>6M transactions), Level 2 (1M-6M), Level 3 (20K-1M), Level 4 (<20K).

attributes.name: pci_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Current PCI DSS compliance status of the merchant account. Non-compliant accounts may face processing restrictions or higher fees.

attributes.name: pci_validation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Last Validation Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent PCI DSS compliance validation or attestation for this merchant account.

attributes.name: real_time_settlement_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account supports real-time or near-real-time settlement where funds are transferred to the merchant immediately or within minutes of transaction authorization.

attributes.name: recurring_billing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is configured to support recurring or subscription-based billing transactions.

attributes.name: reserve_account_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merchant account is required to maintain a reserve account (holdback) to cover potential chargebacks, refunds, or other liabilities.

attributes.name: reserve_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction volume withheld in reserve account to cover potential chargebacks and refunds. Null if no reserve is required.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk classification tier assigned to this merchant account based on underwriting assessment, industry category, transaction patterns, and fraud/chargeback history.

attributes.name: sca_exemption_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is permitted to apply Strong Customer Authentication exemptions for low-risk or low-value transactions under PSD2 regulations.

attributes.name: settlement_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of business days between transaction capture and settlement disbursement to the merchant. Standard is T+1 or T+2; higher-risk accounts may have longer delays.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules, Card Scheme Settlement Rules

attributes.name: single_transaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount (in processing currency) permitted for a single transaction on this account. Transactions exceeding this limit will be declined.

attributes.name: supported_card_schemes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of card payment networks enabled for this account (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, JCB, UnionPay, Diners).

attributes.name: supported_payment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment methods enabled for this account (e.g., card_present, card_not_present, digital_wallet, ach, bank_transfer, qr_code, bnpl).

attributes.name: three_ds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether 3-D Secure authentication is mandatory for card-not-present transactions on this account to comply with Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) requirements.

attributes.name: three_ds_version
attributes.description: Version of the 3-D Secure authentication protocol configured for this account (1.0, 2.0, 2.1, 2.2).

attributes.name: tokenization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment tokenization is enabled for this account to replace sensitive Primary Account Number (PAN) data with non-sensitive tokens.
attributes.references: EMVCo Payment Tokenization Specification, PCI DSS

products.name: mcc_assignment
products.description: Records the Merchant Category Code (MCC) assignment for a merchant or merchant location, including the assigned MCC value, assignment date, assigning authority (card scheme or acquirer), assignment rationale, previous MCC if changed, effective date, and expiry date. Tracks MCC history for interchange qualification, fraud risk profiling, and regulatory reporting. MCC drives interchange rate eligibility and spending category analytics.

attributes.name: mcc_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the MCC assignment record. Primary key for the MCC assignment entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or manager who approved this MCC assignment, if a separate approval step is required. Nullable if no approval workflow exists or approval is pending.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system operator who created or approved this MCC assignment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system operator who last modified this MCC assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant to whom this MCC is assigned. Links to the merchant master record.

attributes.name: merchant_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific merchant location or outlet for which this MCC is assigned. Nullable if MCC applies to the entire merchant entity rather than a specific location.

attributes.name: primary_mcc_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system operator who created or approved this MCC assignment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: tertiary_mcc_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system operator who last modified this MCC assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the MCC assignment was approved by the designated approver. Nullable if approval is not required or has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: assigning_authority
attributes.description: Entity that assigned or approved the MCC. Can be a card scheme (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover) or the acquiring bank/payment facilitator. Determines the authoritative source for the MCC classification.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MCC was assigned to the merchant or merchant location. Represents the business event date of the assignment decision.

attributes.name: assignment_rationale
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or business justification for the MCC assignment. May include details about the merchant's primary business activity, product mix, or regulatory considerations that influenced the MCC selection.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MCC assignment. Active assignments are used for transaction processing; pending assignments await approval; suspended or revoked assignments are temporarily or permanently disabled.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for changing the MCC from a previous assignment. Applicable only when previous_mcc_code is populated. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: business_change|correction|scheme_mandate|fraud_mitigation|merchant_request|regulatory_requirement|audit_finding|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MCC assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the MCC assignment becomes active and is used for transaction processing, interchange qualification, and reporting. May differ from assignment_date if there is a planned future activation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MCC assignment expires or is no longer valid. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Used to track MCC changes and historical assignments.

attributes.name: interchange_qualification_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the impact of this MCC assignment on interchange rate qualification. Certain MCCs qualify for enhanced or premium interchange rates, while others may result in downgrades or restrictions.
attributes.references: Visa Interchange Reimbursement Fees (IRF), Mastercard Interchange Programs

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MCC assignment record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mcc_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code that classifies the merchant's type of business. Determines interchange rates, spending category analytics, and fraud risk profiling. Assigned by card schemes (Visa, Mastercard) or acquirer.

attributes.name: mcc_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the MCC code, describing the business category (e.g., 'Grocery Stores and Supermarkets', 'Airlines', 'Hotels and Motels').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to this MCC assignment. May include operational details, special instructions, or historical context.

attributes.name: previous_mcc_code
attributes.description: The MCC code that was previously assigned to this merchant or location before the current assignment. Nullable for initial assignments. Used to track MCC change history and analyze reclassification patterns.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Regulatory or compliance reporting category associated with this MCC. Used for AML/CTF reporting, tax reporting (e.g., 1099-K thresholds), and industry-specific regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Risk classification associated with this MCC for fraud detection and prevention purposes. High-risk MCCs (e.g., gambling, adult entertainment, travel) trigger enhanced monitoring and fraud rules.

attributes.name: scheme_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the card scheme approved this MCC assignment. Nullable if scheme approval is not required or has not yet been obtained.

attributes.name: scheme_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or case ID provided by the card scheme when approving this MCC assignment. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: scheme_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MCC assignment requires explicit approval from the card scheme (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) before it can be activated. True for high-risk or restricted MCCs.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system from which this MCC assignment record originated (e.g., Merchant Management System, CRM, card scheme portal).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this MCC assignment record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

products.name: merchant_pricing_plan
products.description: Defines the commercial pricing plan assigned to a merchant — the fee structure governing MDR (Merchant Discount Rate), interchange pass-through model, flat-rate or tiered pricing, monthly minimums, setup fees, PCI compliance fees, and chargeback fees. Stores plan name, pricing model type (flat-rate, interchange-plus, tiered, blended), effective date, expiry date, and negotiated rate overrides. SSOT for merchant commercial pricing configuration.
products.reference: MDR - Merchant Discount Rate; IRF - Interchange Reimbursement Fee

attributes.name: merchant_pricing_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pricing plan. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Pricing plans are defined per currency; referencing the currency master ensures consistent pricing and compliance with local regulations.

attributes.name: ach_transaction_fee_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Clearing House (ACH) Transaction Fee Amount
attributes.description: Fee charged per ACH (bank transfer) transaction processed for the merchant, expressed in the plan's base currency. Typically lower than card transaction fees.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Network Rules; Payment Processing Platform

attributes.name: amex_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Separate MDR percentage applied specifically to American Express card transactions, which often have different pricing than Visa/Mastercard, expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: American Express Merchant Agreement; Card Scheme Rules

attributes.name: avs_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged per transaction when Address Verification System (AVS) checks are performed, expressed in the plan's base currency. Helps reduce fraud risk for card-not-present transactions.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Fraud Detection Platform

attributes.name: batch_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged per settlement batch submitted by the merchant, expressed in the plan's base currency. Applies to merchants using batch settlement rather than real-time capture.
attributes.references: Transaction Processing Platform; Merchant Service Agreement

attributes.name: chargeback_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the merchant for each chargeback dispute, regardless of outcome, expressed in the plan's base currency. Covers administrative and processing costs.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: The minimum contract duration in months that the merchant must commit to when assigned this pricing plan. Null for month-to-month plans.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or administrator who created this pricing plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: currency_conversion_markup_percentage
attributes.description: Markup percentage applied to the foreign exchange (FX) rate when Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) is offered to cardholders, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 for 3.00% above spot rate).
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; FX and DCC Standards

attributes.name: debit_card_rate_percentage
attributes.description: MDR percentage applied specifically to debit card transactions, typically lower than credit card rates due to Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) caps, expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation II; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: early_termination_fee_amount
attributes.description: Penalty fee charged if the merchant terminates the agreement before the contract term expires, expressed in the plan's base currency. Null if no early termination penalty applies.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pricing plan becomes binding and applicable to assigned merchants. Transactions on or after this date are governed by this plan's terms.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing plan ceases to be valid. Nullable for open-ended plans. Transactions after this date require a new plan assignment.

attributes.name: interchange_markup_percentage
attributes.description: The markup percentage added on top of the actual interchange cost in interchange-plus pricing models (e.g., 0.0050 for 0.50% above interchange). Null for non-interchange-plus models.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Merchant Service Agreement

attributes.name: interchange_passthrough_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether actual interchange fees (IRF) are passed through to the merchant at cost (true) or absorbed into a blended rate (false). True for interchange-plus and cost-plus models.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Interchange Reimbursement Fee Standards

attributes.name: international_transaction_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Additional percentage fee applied to cross-border transactions where the card issuer is in a different country than the merchant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0100 for 1.00%).
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Cross-Border Payment Standards

attributes.name: mdr_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The base percentage rate charged to the merchant per transaction, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0275 for 2.75%). This is the primary revenue component for flat-rate and blended pricing models.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Merchant Service Agreement

attributes.name: merchant_pricing_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing plan. Active plans are available for assignment; inactive plans are no longer offered but may still govern existing merchants; pending plans are under approval; suspended plans are temporarily unavailable; archived plans are historical records only.
attributes.references: Merchant Management System - Pricing Configuration Module

attributes.name: mid_qualified_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The middle MDR percentage tier in tiered pricing models, applied to transactions that partially meet qualification criteria (e.g., keyed-in transactions, rewards cards), expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Tiered Pricing Standards

attributes.name: monthly_account_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly account maintenance or service fee charged to the merchant, independent of transaction volume, expressed in the plan's base currency.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Payment Processing Platform

attributes.name: monthly_minimum_fee_amount
attributes.description: The minimum monthly fee the merchant must pay regardless of transaction volume, expressed in the plan's base currency. If monthly processing fees fall below this threshold, the merchant is charged the difference.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Payment Processing Platform

attributes.name: non_qualified_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The highest MDR percentage tier in tiered pricing models, applied to transactions that fail qualification criteria (e.g., corporate cards, international cards, manually entered), expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Tiered Pricing Standards

attributes.name: payfac_sub_merchant_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing plan is available for assignment to sub-merchants under a Payment Facilitator (PayFac) model. True if eligible for PayFac sub-merchants; false if only for direct merchants.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PayFac Program Standards

attributes.name: pci_compliance_fee_amount
attributes.description: Annual or monthly fee charged to merchants for PCI DSS compliance program administration, security scanning, and attestation support, expressed in the plan's base currency.
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council; PCI DSS Requirements

attributes.name: pci_non_compliance_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monthly penalty fee charged to merchants who fail to maintain PCI DSS compliance, expressed in the plan's base currency. Escalates with duration of non-compliance.
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council; PCI DSS Requirements

attributes.name: per_transaction_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee charged per transaction in addition to the percentage-based MDR, expressed in the plan's base currency (e.g., 0.10 for $0.10 per transaction).
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Payment Processing Platform

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the pricing plan, used in contracts and merchant communications.
attributes.references: Merchant Management System - Pricing Configuration Module

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the pricing plan, including key features, target merchant segments, and value proposition.
attributes.references: Merchant Management System - Pricing Configuration Module

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the pricing plan (e.g., 'Standard Retail', 'Enterprise Plus', 'Startup Flat Rate').
attributes.references: Merchant Management System - Pricing Configuration Module

attributes.name: pricing_model_type
attributes.description: The fundamental pricing structure applied to merchant transactions. Flat-rate charges a single percentage; interchange-plus passes through interchange costs plus a markup; tiered groups transactions into qualified/mid-qualified/non-qualified buckets; blended averages all transaction types; cost-plus adds a fixed margin to actual costs; custom indicates bespoke negotiated terms.
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: qualified_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The lowest MDR percentage tier in tiered pricing models, applied to transactions that meet all qualification criteria (e.g., swiped consumer credit cards), expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Tiered Pricing Standards

attributes.name: refund_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the merchant for processing a refund or credit transaction, expressed in the plan's base currency. Some plans waive this fee; others charge per refund.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Transaction Processing Platform

attributes.name: retrieval_request_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the merchant for each retrieval request (pre-chargeback inquiry) from the issuing bank, expressed in the plan's base currency.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: setup_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time fee charged when a merchant is onboarded and assigned to this pricing plan, covering account setup, KYC processing, and initial configuration, expressed in the plan's base currency.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Merchant Management System

attributes.name: statement_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for generating and delivering monthly merchant statements (paper or electronic), expressed in the plan's base currency.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Payment Processing Platform

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or administrator who last modified this pricing plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing plan record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: voice_authorization_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged when a merchant obtains authorization via phone call to the authorization center rather than electronic authorization, expressed in the plan's base currency.
attributes.references: Payment Gateway and Authorization Engine; Merchant Service Agreement

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Monthly transaction volume threshold (in base currency) that triggers preferential pricing or tier upgrades. Used in volume-based pricing models where rates decrease as volume increases.
attributes.references: Merchant Service Agreement; Payment Processing Platform

products.name: merchant_fee_schedule
products.description: Granular fee line-item schedule associated with a merchant pricing plan. Captures individual fee types (authorization fee, capture fee, refund fee, chargeback fee, monthly service fee, PCI non-compliance fee, early termination fee), fee amount or rate, fee basis (per-transaction, percentage, flat monthly), applicable card scheme, applicable transaction type, and effective date range. Enables detailed merchant billing and revenue recognition.

products.name: scheme_event
products.description: Records scheme-level operational events — scheduled maintenance windows, unplanned outages, emergency routing changes, and scheme-initiated parameter pushes. Captures event type, affected schemes, start/end timestamps, impact severity, and resolution notes. Distinct from connectivity_event which tracks endpoint-level link events.

attributes.name: scheme_event_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for each scheme-level operational event.

attributes.name: scheme_id

attributes.name: affected_mcc_codes

attributes.name: end_timestamp

attributes.name: event_timestamp

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Category of the scheme event: scheduled maintenance, unplanned outage, emergency routing change, or scheme‑initiated parameter push.

attributes.name: impact_scope

attributes.name: is_emergency

attributes.name: parameter_name

attributes.name: parameter_value
attributes.description: New value assigned to the scheme parameter during a parameter_push event.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Notes on how the event was resolved, including actions taken and responsible teams.

attributes.name: scheme_event_description
attributes.description: Free‑text narrative describing the cause, context, and details of the event.

attributes.name: scheme_event_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the event from creation to closure.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the event, used for prioritization and escalation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned start time for maintenance windows or the beginning of an outage period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the event record.

products.name: scheme_obligation_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the mapping between a payment scheme and a regulatory obligation. It captures the period during which a scheme must satisfy a specific obligation.. Existence Justification: Each payment scheme must comply with multiple regulatory obligations, and each regulatory obligation can apply to multiple schemes. The compliance team actively maintains a mapping that records the effective start and end dates of each scheme‑obligation relationship.

attributes.name: scheme_obligation_mapping_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scheme Obligation Mapping - Scheme Obligation Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the scheme_obligation_mapping association

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scheme Obligation Mapping - Regulatory Obligation Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory obligation

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the payment scheme

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the obligation starts to apply to the scheme

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the obligation ceases to apply to the scheme

products.name: network_routing_rule2
products.description: This association product represents the routing rule that links a payment card scheme to an acquirer endpoint. It captures the operational parameters used by the payment network to decide where to send transactions for a given scheme.. Existence Justification: Payment processors actively manage routing rules that map card schemes to acquirer endpoints. Each rule records which scheme(s) can be sent to which endpoint(s), with priority, match criteria, and default flags. Both a scheme can be routed to multiple endpoints and an endpoint can serve multiple schemes, and the rules themselves are a managed business artifact.

attributes.name: network_routing_rule2_id
attributes.description: Primary key for network_routing_rule2

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Auto-generated FK linking siloed routing_rule to scheme

products.name: scheme_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between a payment scheme and a POS terminal. It captures activation date, certification status, and compliance deadline for each scheme‑terminal pairing.. Existence Justification: Each POS terminal can be certified for multiple payment card schemes, and each scheme is supported by many terminals across the network. Certification is an operational record that is created, updated, and retired by the business, capturing activation dates, status, and compliance deadlines for every terminal‑scheme pairing.

attributes.name: scheme_certification_id

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the POS terminal

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the payment scheme

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date the terminal was certified for the scheme

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the certification

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the terminal must meet scheme compliance requirements

products.name: dcc_pricing
products.description: Represents the configured DCC pricing relationship between a payment scheme and a currency pair. Each record stores the margin, minimum transaction amount, offer presentation method, and compliance details that are specific to the scheme‑currency pair combination.. Existence Justification: In the payments fintech platform, each card scheme (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) can be offered with DCC pricing for many currency pairs, and each currency pair can have DCC pricing defined for multiple schemes. The business actively configures these scheme‑currency pair settings (margin, minimum amount, offer method) as a managed entity.

attributes.name: dcc_pricing_id

attributes.name: currency_pair_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the currency pair

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the payment scheme

attributes.name: dcc_margin_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage margin applied to DCC transactions for this scheme‑pair

attributes.name: min_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount required for DCC offer

attributes.name: offer_presentation_method
attributes.description: Method used to present the DCC offer to the cardholder (e.g., popup, inline)

attributes.name: scheme_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance flag or notes for the scheme regarding this DCC offering

products.name: regulatory_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between a payment scheme and a regulatory jurisdiction. It captures jurisdiction‑specific compliance attributes for each scheme, enabling tracking of compliance status, remediation actions, and effective periods.. Existence Justification: A payment scheme can be subject to multiple regulatory jurisdictions, and a regulatory jurisdiction can govern multiple payment schemes. The compliance team actively tracks each scheme‑jurisdiction pairing with attributes such as compliance type, status, effective dates, and remediation details. This relationship is managed as a distinct business entity.

domains.name: interchange
domains.description: SSOT for network and interchange economics — IRF tables, MDR configurations, MSF schedules, scheme fee structures, BIN-level interchange qualification rules, and Durbin Amendment compliance tiers. Supports revenue recognition and cost-of-acceptance calculations for acquiring and issuing portfolios.
domains.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, Regulation II (Durbin)

products.name: irf_table
products.description: Master reference table for Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) schedules published by card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover). Stores interchange rate categories, rate percentages, per-transaction fees, effective dates, card type applicability, transaction type qualifiers, and scheme-specific program identifiers. This is the authoritative SSOT for all interchange rate definitions used in cost-of-acceptance calculations.

attributes.name: irf_table_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interchange reimbursement fee table record.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Card scheme lookup drives scheme‑specific interchange rates and compliance checks.

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.irf_rate_category. Business justification: irf_table references its category; adds irf_rate_category_id FK to irf_rate_category

attributes.name: issuer_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires mapping issuer ISO country codes to country reference for compliance audits.

attributes.name: acquirer_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the acquiring bank. Used for domestic vs. cross-border interchange rate determination. Null indicates rate applies regardless of acquirer country.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: authorization_method
attributes.description: Card authorization method required for this interchange rate (chip, contactless, magnetic stripe, manual entry, ecommerce, token). Null indicates no specific method requirement.
attributes.references: EMVCo; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: bin_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of the BIN/IIN range to which this interchange rate applies. Used for BIN-level interchange qualification rules. Null indicates no BIN restriction.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: bin_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of the BIN/IIN range to which this interchange rate applies. Used for BIN-level interchange qualification rules. Null indicates no BIN restriction.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: card_product_tier
attributes.description: Card product tier or brand level (e.g., Standard, Rewards, Premium, Signature, World, World Elite, Platinum, Infinite). Higher tiers typically carry higher interchange rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|rewards|premium|signature|world|world_elite|platinum|infinite — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Type of payment card to which this interchange rate applies (credit, debit, prepaid, commercial, purchasing). Critical qualifier for rate selection.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Regulation II Durbin Amendment

attributes.name: cost_of_acceptance_category
attributes.description: Internal classification category used for cost-of-acceptance reporting and analysis (e.g., low-cost, standard, premium, high-cost). Supports merchant pricing strategy and portfolio profitability analysis.

attributes.name: durbin_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum interchange fee amount allowed under Regulation II Durbin Amendment for regulated debit transactions. Null if not subject to Durbin caps.
attributes.references: Regulation II Durbin Amendment; Federal Reserve System

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rate is subject to Regulation II Durbin Amendment caps (True for regulated debit, False otherwise). Critical for US debit interchange compliance.
attributes.references: Regulation II Durbin Amendment; Federal Reserve System

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this interchange rate schedule expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended schedule currently in effect.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this interchange rate schedule becomes effective and applicable to transactions. Part of the temporal validity window for this rate.

attributes.name: interchange_category_code
attributes.description: Scheme-specific code identifying the interchange rate category (e.g., CPS Retail, Merit III, Core Value, Standard). This is the authoritative classification used by the card scheme.

attributes.name: interchange_category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the interchange rate category (e.g., Card Present Signature Preferred Retail, Electronic Commerce Basic).

attributes.name: interchange_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the interchange fee amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: interchange_fixed_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed per-transaction fee component of the interchange in the currency specified by interchange_currency_code (e.g., $0.10). Combined with percentage rate to calculate total IRF.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Regulation II Durbin Amendment

attributes.name: interchange_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate component of the interchange fee applied to the transaction amount (e.g., 1.65% stored as 0.0165). Used in cost-of-acceptance calculations.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Regulation II Durbin Amendment

attributes.name: internal_rate_code
attributes.description: Internal company-specific code or identifier for this interchange rate, used for mapping to internal pricing and cost-of-acceptance systems. May differ from scheme category code.

attributes.name: maximum_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount for which this interchange rate applies, in the currency specified by interchange_currency_code. Null indicates no maximum.

attributes.name: merchant_category_code
attributes.description: Four-digit ISO 18245 merchant category code to which this interchange rate applies. Null indicates rate applies across all MCCs. Used for industry-specific interchange qualification.
attributes.references: ISO 18245; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount required for this interchange rate to apply, in the currency specified by interchange_currency_code. Null indicates no minimum.

attributes.name: program_identifier
attributes.description: Scheme-specific program or initiative identifier associated with this interchange rate (e.g., Visa CPS, Mastercard Merit, Amex OptBlue). Used for program-level reporting and qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed business rules and conditions that must be met for a transaction to qualify for this interchange rate (e.g., EMV chip, AVS match, settlement within 24 hours). Free-text field capturing scheme-specific requirements.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; EMVCo

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this interchange rate schedule (active, pending, expired, superseded, withdrawn). Used for rate version management and historical analysis.

attributes.name: rate_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this interchange rate schedule, assigned by the card scheme. Used to track rate changes over time and ensure correct rate application.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interchange rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this interchange rate data originated (e.g., Visa Rate Feed, Mastercard Portal, Manual Entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interchange rate record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting regulatory compliance considerations for this interchange rate (e.g., PSD2 caps, Durbin Amendment applicability, regional regulations). Used for compliance audit and legal review.
attributes.references: PSD2; Regulation II Durbin Amendment; PCI DSS

attributes.name: scheme_bulletin_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the card scheme bulletin or notice that announced this interchange rate change. Used for traceability and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: scheme_publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the card scheme officially published this interchange rate schedule. Used for audit trail and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: settlement_timeframe_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours between authorization and settlement for this interchange rate to apply (e.g., 24, 48, 72). Null indicates no settlement timeframe requirement.

attributes.name: transaction_region
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the transaction (domestic, intra-regional, inter-regional, cross-border). Determines applicable interchange rate tier.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PSD2

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction to which this interchange rate applies (card present, card not present, ecommerce, mail/telephone order, recurring, contactless). Key qualifier for interchange eligibility.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PCI DSS

products.name: irf_rate_category
products.description: Defines the interchange rate category taxonomy used by each card scheme — e.g., Visa CPS/Retail, Mastercard Merit III, Amex OptBlue tiers. Captures category code, category name, qualifying criteria (card-present/card-not-present, EMV, AVS, MCC range), downgrade rules, and the parent scheme. Enables BIN-level and MCC-level interchange qualification logic.

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) Rate Category ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interchange rate category. Primary key.

attributes.name: scheme_id

attributes.name: authorization_timeframe_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours between authorization and capture for transactions to qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: avs_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Address Verification System (AVS) validation is required to qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: bin_range_end
attributes.description: The ending Bank Identification Number (BIN) or Issuer Identification Number (IIN) in the range of card products that qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: bin_range_start
attributes.description: The starting Bank Identification Number (BIN) or Issuer Identification Number (IIN) in the range of card products that qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: card_not_present_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rate category applies to card-not-present (CNP) transactions such as e-commerce, mail order, or telephone order.

attributes.name: card_present_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rate category applies to card-present (CP) transactions where the physical card is presented at the Point of Sale (POS).

attributes.name: category_code

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the interchange rate category as published by the card scheme (e.g., Visa CPS/Retail, Mastercard Merit III, Amex OptBlue Standard).
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Standards

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: The classification of the interchange rate category based on card product type and transaction characteristics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|premium|commercial|debit|credit|prepaid|rewards|government|healthcare — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contactless_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether contactless NFC transactions are eligible for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this interchange rate category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_transaction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rate category applies to cross-border transactions where the acquiring and issuing banks are in different countries.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 4217 Currency Code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount thresholds and interchange rates associated with this category.

attributes.name: cvv_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Card Verification Value (CVV) validation is required to qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: domestic_transaction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rate category applies to domestic transactions where the acquiring and issuing banks are in the same country.

attributes.name: downgrade_category_code
attributes.description: The interchange rate category code to which a transaction will be downgraded if it fails to meet the qualification criteria for this category.

attributes.name: downgrade_rules_description

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: emv_chip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether EMV chip authentication is required for transactions to qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this interchange rate category ceases to be active and is no longer applicable to new transactions.

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this interchange rate category within the card schemes published rate structure.

attributes.name: mcc_range_end
attributes.description: The ending Merchant Category Code (MCC) in the range of merchant types that qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: mcc_range_start
attributes.description: The starting Merchant Category Code (MCC) in the range of merchant types that qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: parent_category_code

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking used to determine which interchange rate category applies when a transaction qualifies for multiple categories. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: qualification_criteria_description
attributes.description: A detailed textual description of all the business and technical criteria that a transaction must meet to qualify for this interchange rate category.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code indicating the geographic scope where this interchange rate category applies.

attributes.name: scheme_publication_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier or document name from the card schemes official publication where this interchange rate category is defined (e.g., Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement Fees April 2024).

attributes.name: three_d_secure_required

attributes.name: transaction_amount_max
attributes.description: The maximum transaction amount allowed to qualify for this interchange rate category, in the base currency of the scheme.

attributes.name: transaction_amount_min
attributes.description: The minimum transaction amount required to qualify for this interchange rate category, in the base currency of the scheme.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: merchant_segment_code

attributes.name: mid

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_amount

attributes.name: monthly_subscription_fee_amount

attributes.name: monthly_volume_threshold_amount

attributes.name: tier_1_rate_percent

attributes.name: tier_2_rate_percent

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold_amount

attributes.name: tier_3_rate_percent

attributes.name: transaction_channel

products.name: msf_schedule

Stores monthly/annual fee amounts, per-transaction service fees, minimum monthly fees, statement fees, PCI compliance fees, chargeback fees, and the applicable merchant tier or program. Supports revenue recognition for the acquiring portfolio.

attributes.name: msf_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant service fee schedule record.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this fee schedule for activation.

attributes.name: mcc_id

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant to whom this fee schedule applies.

attributes.name: pricing_tier_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the pricing tier or program that defines the fee structure for this merchant.

attributes.name: transaction_type_id

attributes.name: annual_fee_amount

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: avs_fee_amount

attributes.name: batch_fee_amount
