attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Payment card network or scheme to which this fee schedule applies (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, JCB, UnionPay, or all). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|amex|discover|jcb|unionpay|all — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: chargeback_fee_amount

attributes.name: contract_term_months

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: durbin_exempt_flag

attributes.name: early_termination_fee_amount

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: interchange_pass_through_flag

attributes.name: international_transaction_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional fee charged for cross-border or international payment transactions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fee schedule record was last modified.

attributes.name: monthly_account_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly account maintenance or service fee charged to the merchant.

attributes.name: monthly_minimum_fee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum monthly fee that the merchant must pay regardless of transaction volume.

attributes.name: msf_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the merchant service fee schedule.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this fee schedule, including special terms or exceptions.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_fee_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliance Fee Amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for PCI DSS compliance validation, scanning, or non-compliance penalties.

attributes.name: per_transaction_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee amount charged per transaction processed under this schedule.

attributes.name: percentage_rate

attributes.name: retrieval_request_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for processing a retrieval request (pre-chargeback inquiry) from the issuing bank.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to recognize revenue from this fee schedule (accrual, cash, deferred, straight-line).

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for this merchant service fee schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee schedule structure (standard, custom, promotional, tiered, interchange-plus, flat-rate).

attributes.name: statement_fee_amount

attributes.name: voice_authorization_fee_amount

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold_amount

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold_count
attributes.description: Monthly transaction count threshold that qualifies the merchant for this fee schedule tier.

products.name: scheme_fee_table
products.description: Card scheme assessment and network fee table capturing all fees levied by Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, and other schemes on acquirers and issuers. Includes assessment rates, network access fees, cross-border fees, digital enablement fees, misuse-of-authorization fees, and scheme-specific surcharges. Effective date ranges and volume tier thresholds are tracked for accurate cost modeling.

attributes.name: scheme_fee_table_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the scheme fee table record.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Fee tables are keyed by card scheme; linking to scheme reference enables unified fee reporting.

attributes.name: assessment_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which assessment fees are calculated: gross volume (total transaction value including refunds), net volume (purchases minus refunds), or transaction count.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: bin_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of BIN/IIN range to which this fee applies. Used for BIN-level interchange qualification rules. Null if fee applies to all BINs.
attributes.references: ISO 7812; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: bin_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of BIN/IIN range to which this fee applies. Used for BIN-level interchange qualification rules. Null if fee applies to all BINs.
attributes.references: ISO 7812; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: card_present_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fee applies to card-present (POS/mPOS), card-not-present (e-commerce/MOTO), or both transaction environments.

attributes.name: card_product_type
attributes.description: Type of card product to which this fee applies: credit, debit, prepaid, commercial (business/corporate), or all card types.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scheme fee table record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee applies specifically to digital wallet or tokenized transactions (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay). True if digital-wallet-specific, false otherwise.

attributes.name: domestic_international_indicator
attributes.description: Specifies whether the fee applies to domestic transactions (same country acquirer/issuer), international (cross-border), or both.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee applies to Durbin Amendment regulated debit transactions (US Regulation II compliance). True if fee is for regulated debit, false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule expires or is superseded. Null for currently active fee schedules with no defined end date.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this fee schedule becomes effective. Used for accurate cost modeling across time periods.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_code
attributes.description: Scheme-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this fee within the scheme's fee schedule.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the fee is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fee purpose, calculation methodology, and any special conditions or exemptions as published by the card scheme.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_fixed_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee amount per transaction in the fee currency. Null if fee is not fixed-amount-based.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the specific fee as published by the card scheme (e.g., 'Visa Assessment Fee', 'Mastercard Cross-Border Volume Fee', 'Amex Digital Enablement Fee').
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to transaction value, expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.00125 for 12.5 basis points). Null if fee is not percentage-based.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_rate_type
attributes.description: Structure of the fee calculation: percentage (basis points of transaction value), fixed (flat amount per transaction), tiered (volume-based brackets), or hybrid (combination).
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fee schedule: active (currently in effect), pending (announced but not yet effective), superseded (replaced by newer schedule), or retired (no longer applicable).
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Category of scheme fee: assessment (volume-based), network access (fixed connectivity), cross-border (international transaction), digital enablement (tokenization/digital wallet), misuse-of-authorization (declined auth reuse), or scheme-specific surcharge.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scheme fee table record was last updated, reflecting any changes to fee rates, effective dates, or other attributes.

attributes.name: maximum_fee_amount
attributes.description: Maximum fee amount charged per transaction, capping percentage-based fees for high-value transactions.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: mcc_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of MCC range to which this fee applies. Used for merchant-category-specific fees. Null if fee applies to all MCCs.
attributes.references: ISO 18245; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: mcc_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of MCC range to which this fee applies. Used for merchant-category-specific fees. Null if fee applies to all MCCs.
attributes.references: ISO 18245; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: minimum_fee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum fee amount charged per transaction, regardless of percentage calculation. Ensures floor for low-value transactions.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Indicates which party in the payment chain is charged this fee: acquirer (merchant's bank), issuer (cardholder's bank), or both.
attributes.references: ISO 8583; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code where this fee applies (e.g., USA, GBR, EUR for Eurozone). Null if fee is global.

attributes.name: scheme_publication_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the official scheme publication, bulletin, or rules document where this fee is defined (e.g., 'Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement Fees April 2024').
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: three_d_secure_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee applies to transactions authenticated via 3-D Secure protocol (3DS 1.0 or 3DS 2.0). True if 3DS-specific, false otherwise.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction to which this fee applies: purchase, cash advance, refund, chargeback, or all transaction types.

attributes.name: volume_tier_lower_bound
attributes.description: Lower threshold of transaction volume or count for tiered fee structures. Null if fee is not volume-tiered.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: volume_tier_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for volume tiers: transaction count (number of transactions) or transaction value (monetary volume).
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: volume_tier_upper_bound
attributes.description: Upper threshold of transaction volume or count for tiered fee structures. Null for open-ended top tier.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards and Compliance

products.name: bin_interchange_rule
products.description: BIN (Bank Identification Number) level interchange qualification rules mapping BIN ranges to applicable interchange rate categories. Captures BIN range start/end, issuing bank identifier, card product type (debit, credit, prepaid, commercial), regulated/unregulated flag under Durbin Amendment, applicable IRF category codes, and scheme identifier. Core to real-time interchange qualification during transaction processing.

attributes.name: bin_interchange_rule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Identification Number (BIN) Interchange Rule ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key identifying a BIN-level interchange qualification rule record in the silver layer lakehouse. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a configuration/rule resource governing interchange qualification for a BIN range.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issuing bank or financial institution that issued the card associated with this BIN range. The issuing bank is the cardholder's bank in the payment chain.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation II

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.irf_rate_category. Business justification: bin_interchange_rule references IRF category; adds irf_rate_category_id FK

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the card scheme (payment network brand) governing this interchange rule, such as Visa, Mastercard, American Express, or Discover. Links to the scheme reference product.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; EMVCo

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_bin_interchange_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bin_interchange_rule_id of the newer rule that supersedes this record when rule_status is 'superseded'. Enables rule lineage tracking and historical interchange qualification reconstruction.
attributes.references: SOX; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: authorization_indicator
attributes.description: Specifies the type of authorization associated with this interchange rule: pre-authorization (hotel/car rental), final authorization, or incremental authorization. Different authorization types may qualify for distinct interchange rates.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: avs_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Address Verification System (AVS) check is required for a transaction to qualify for this interchange rate category. AVS validation is a fraud prevention measure commonly required for card-not-present interchange qualification.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: bin_range_end
attributes.description: The ending BIN (Bank Identification Number) of the BIN range to which this interchange qualification rule applies. Together with bin_range_start, defines the full BIN range covered by this rule.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812; PCI DSS v4.0; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: bin_range_start
attributes.description: The starting BIN (Bank Identification Number), also known as IIN (Issuer Identification Number), of the BIN range to which this interchange qualification rule applies. Supports 6-digit legacy BINs and 8-digit extended BINs per ISO/IEC 7812.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812; PCI DSS v4.0; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: The payment network brand associated with this BIN range (e.g., VISA, MASTERCARD). Used in conjunction with scheme_id for interchange qualification and reporting.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; EMVCo

attributes.name: card_not_present_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rule applies to card-not-present (CNP) transactions, such as e-commerce, mail order, or telephone order (MOTO) transactions. CNP transactions typically carry higher interchange rates due to elevated fraud risk.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: card_present_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rule applies to card-present (CP) transactions, where the physical card or device is used at a POS or mPOS terminal. Card-present transactions typically qualify for lower interchange rates than card-not-present.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; EMVCo EMV Chip Specifications

attributes.name: card_product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the card product associated with this BIN range, determining the applicable interchange rate tier. Debit and prepaid cards may be subject to Durbin Amendment regulated caps; commercial and government cards follow separate interchange schedules. Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: debit|credit|prepaid|commercial|government|healthcare — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 7816

attributes.name: contactless_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rule applies to contactless NFC (Near Field Communication) transactions, including tap-to-pay and mobile wallet payments. Contactless qualification may carry distinct interchange rates from contact chip transactions.
attributes.references: EMVCo Contactless Specifications; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; NFC Forum

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the issuing country associated with this BIN range (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines domestic vs. cross-border interchange rate applicability and regulatory jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; GDPR; PSD2

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BIN interchange rule record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail and data lineage purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rule applies specifically to cross-border transactions where the issuing country differs from the acquiring country. Cross-border transactions typically attract higher interchange rates and additional scheme fees.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PSD2; SWIFT

attributes.name: data_quality_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the level of transaction data (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) required for interchange qualification under this rule. Level 2/3 data (enhanced transaction detail for B2B/commercial cards) may qualify for lower interchange rates.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: durbin_exempt_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a BIN range is exempt from Durbin Amendment regulated interchange caps. Applicable only when durbin_regulated_flag is False. Small issuers (assets < $10B), government-administered programs, and certain prepaid products qualify for exemption.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Dodd-Frank Act Section 1075; CFPB

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIN range is subject to the Durbin Amendment interchange fee caps under Federal Reserve Regulation II. True = regulated (issuer assets ≥ $10B threshold, capped at 21 cents + 0.05% + 1 cent fraud adjustment); False = unregulated (exempt issuers, higher interchange applies).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Dodd-Frank Act Section 1075

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this BIN interchange qualification rule ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no defined expiry. Used to manage rule versioning and historical interchange cost analysis. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation II

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BIN interchange qualification rule becomes effective and is applied during transaction processing and interchange qualification. Aligns with scheme fee schedule publication cycles (typically semi-annual for Visa/Mastercard). Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation II

attributes.name: emv_chip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether EMV (Europay Mastercard Visa) chip processing is required for a transaction to qualify for this interchange rate category. EMV chip transactions reduce fraud liability and may qualify for preferential interchange rates.
attributes.references: EMVCo EMV Chip Specifications; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: installment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rule applies to installment payment transactions, including BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) arrangements. Installment transactions may carry distinct interchange qualification criteria.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; CFPB

attributes.name: interchange_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the interchange fixed fee is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for cross-border interchange cost calculations and multi-currency acquiring portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: interchange_fixed_fee
attributes.description: The fixed per-transaction fee component of the interchange, expressed in the applicable currency (e.g., 0.1000 = $0.10 per transaction). Combined with interchange_rate_percent to compute total interchange cost per transaction.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation II

attributes.name: interchange_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage-based component of the interchange fee applied to the transaction amount for qualifying transactions under this BIN rule (e.g., 1.6500 represents 1.65%). Used in cost-of-acceptance calculations for acquiring portfolios. Serves as the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation II; SOX

attributes.name: mcc_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of MCC (Merchant Category Code) values that are included or excluded from this interchange rule, as determined by mcc_restriction_type. For example, '5411,5412,5499' for grocery MCCs. Null when mcc_restriction_type is 'all'.
attributes.references: ISO 18245 (MCC Standard); Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: mcc_restriction_type
attributes.description: Defines how MCC (Merchant Category Code) restrictions apply to this interchange rule: 'all' means no MCC restriction (applies to all MCCs), 'include' means only specified MCCs qualify, 'exclude' means specified MCCs are excluded, 'none' means no transactions qualify regardless of MCC.
attributes.references: ISO 18245 (MCC Standard); Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: recurring_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange rule applies to recurring or subscription-based transactions. Recurring transactions may qualify for specific interchange programs with distinct rate structures.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Card scheme-defined geographic region code associated with this BIN range (e.g., 'AP' for Asia Pacific, 'CEMEA' for Central Europe Middle East Africa, 'LAC' for Latin America and Caribbean, 'NA' for North America). Used for cross-border interchange rate determination.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business code identifying this BIN interchange qualification rule, used in downstream transaction processing and interchange qualification engines. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about this BIN interchange qualification rule, including any special conditions, exceptions, or notes from the card scheme or compliance team.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the BIN interchange qualification rule (e.g., 'Visa Debit Regulated CPS Retail'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BIN interchange qualification rule. Active rules are applied in real-time interchange qualification; superseded rules have been replaced by newer versions; expired rules are past their effective end date. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; SOX

attributes.name: scheme_program_code
attributes.description: Card scheme-assigned program code identifying the specific interchange program under which this rule is classified (e.g., 'CPS/RETAIL', 'EIRF', 'MERIT III', 'WORLD', 'SIGNATURE'). Used for interchange qualification matching in the transaction processing platform.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: source_system_rule_ref
attributes.description: The native rule identifier or reference code from the originating operational system (Transaction Processing Platform or Payment Gateway) from which this BIN interchange rule was sourced. Supports data lineage and reconciliation back to the system of record.

attributes.name: three_ds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether 3-D Secure (3DS) authentication is required for card-not-present transactions to qualify for this interchange rate. 3DS-authenticated transactions may qualify for lower interchange rates and shift fraud liability to the issuer. Relevant under PSD2 SCA requirements.
attributes.references: EMVCo 3-D Secure Specification; PSD2 Article 97 (SCA); Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: tokenization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions using a DPAN (Device Primary Account Number) or network token issued by a TSP (Token Service Provider) for this BIN range are eligible for this interchange rate. Tokenized transactions may qualify for distinct interchange rates.
attributes.references: EMVCo Tokenization Framework; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: transaction_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount (in the fee currency) eligible for this interchange rate category. Transactions exceeding this threshold may be subject to different interchange rates or require additional qualification criteria.

attributes.name: transaction_min_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount (in the fee currency) required for a transaction to qualify for this interchange rate category. Transactions below this threshold may downgrade to a less favorable interchange tier.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BIN interchange rule record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, rule versioning audit, and regulatory compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this BIN interchange rule record, incremented each time the rule is updated. Supports rule versioning and historical interchange qualification audit trails required for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

products.name: durbin_compliance_tier
products.description: Durbin Amendment (Regulation II) compliance tier registry tracking issuer debit card interchange caps and routing requirements. Stores issuer asset threshold classification (regulated vs. exempt), applicable interchange cap (cents per transaction), network exclusivity compliance status, dual-message vs. single-message routing flags, effective date, and Federal Reserve reporting period. SSOT for Durbin regulatory compliance in debit interchange.

attributes.name: durbin_compliance_tier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Durbin Amendment (Regulation II) compliance tier record in the registry. Primary key for the durbin_compliance_tier data product.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment)

attributes.name: annual_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether issuers in this compliance tier are subject to annual Federal Reserve data collection and review (e.g., the Federal Reserve's annual debit card survey under Regulation II). Regulated issuers above the $10 billion threshold are subject to annual reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Federal Reserve Board Debit Card Survey

attributes.name: applicable_geography
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the geographic jurisdiction in which this compliance tier applies. Regulation II is a US domestic regulation; this field is 'USA' for all standard Durbin tiers but supports future multi-jurisdiction extensions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 (Country Codes); Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment)

attributes.name: asset_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Consolidated asset threshold in US dollars used to determine whether an issuer is subject to Regulation II interchange caps. The Federal Reserve sets this at $10 billion; issuers at or above this threshold are regulated. Stored as the threshold value applicable to this tier.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.5; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: bin_range_end
attributes.description: Ending Bank Identification Number (BIN) / Issuer Identification Number (IIN) of the BIN range to which this compliance tier applies. Used in conjunction with bin_range_start to define the full BIN range scope for interchange qualification.
attributes.references: ISO 7812 (Identification of Issuers); Federal Reserve System – Regulation II; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: bin_range_start
attributes.description: Starting Bank Identification Number (BIN) / Issuer Identification Number (IIN) of the BIN range to which this compliance tier applies. Enables BIN-level interchange qualification routing. Stored as a 6–8 digit string per ISO 7812.
attributes.references: ISO 7812 (Identification of Issuers); Federal Reserve System – Regulation II; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: card_scheme
attributes.description: Payment network brand (card scheme) to which this compliance tier applies. Regulation II applies to all debit card networks; however, interchange cap and routing rules may differ by scheme. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|discover|amex|interlink|star|pulse|nyce|maestro|unionpay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; NACHA

attributes.name: compliance_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal compliance team or officer responsible for maintaining and certifying this compliance tier record. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements under SOX and internal governance frameworks.
attributes.references: SOX – Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Internal Compliance Governance; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: cost_of_acceptance_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the directional impact of this compliance tier on merchant cost of acceptance (MDR/MSF). Regulated tiers with capped interchange typically reduce cost of acceptance for merchants; exempt tiers may result in higher interchange and increased merchant cost.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance tier record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit creation trail required for SOX compliance and data lineage in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX – Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which interchange caps and fee amounts in this compliance tier are denominated. Typically 'USD' for Regulation II tiers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 (Currency Codes); Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment)

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this compliance tier record originates or is maintained (e.g., 'Risk and Compliance Management System', 'Transaction Processing Platform'). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Data Warehouse and Analytics Platform; Risk and Compliance Management System

attributes.name: debit_card_type
attributes.description: Type of debit card program covered by this compliance tier. Regulation II exemptions differ by card type — government-administered and certain reloadable prepaid programs are exempt from interchange caps. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: consumer_debit|prepaid|government_benefit|payroll|healthcare_fsa|commercial_debit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.5; CFPB

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this Durbin compliance tier configuration becomes effective and applicable to interchange cap enforcement and routing compliance checks. Aligns with Federal Reserve regulatory reporting periods.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: emv_chip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether EMV (Europay Mastercard Visa) chip card technology is required for transactions qualifying under this compliance tier. Relevant for fraud-adjustment eligibility under Regulation II, which requires issuers to implement chip technology as part of fraud-prevention standards.
attributes.references: EMVCo EMV Chip Specifications; Federal Reserve System – Regulation II 12 CFR 235.4; PCI DSS

attributes.name: enabled_network_count
attributes.description: Number of unaffiliated payment networks on which debit cards in this compliance tier are enabled for routing. Regulation II requires a minimum of two unaffiliated networks. Used to validate network exclusivity compliance.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.7; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this Durbin compliance tier configuration ceases to be effective. Null for open-ended tiers that remain in force until superseded. Used in date-range queries for point-in-time compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: fed_regulation_citation
attributes.description: Specific Federal Register or Code of Federal Regulations citation underpinning this compliance tier (e.g., '12 CFR Part 235', 'Federal Register Vol. 76 No. 130'). Provides a direct regulatory audit trail for compliance and legal review.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Federal Register

attributes.name: fed_reporting_period
attributes.description: Federal Reserve reporting period to which this compliance tier applies, formatted as YYYY-H1, YYYY-H2, YYYY-Q1, etc. The Federal Reserve collects debit card interchange data annually; this field links the tier to the applicable regulatory data collection cycle.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Federal Reserve Board Debit Card Survey

attributes.name: fraud_adjustment_cap_cents
attributes.description: Maximum additional interchange allowance in US cents per transaction for fraud-prevention activities, available to eligible regulated issuers under Regulation II. Currently set at 1 cent per transaction by the Federal Reserve. Null if fraud_adjustment_eligible is false.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.4; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: fraud_adjustment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether issuers in this compliance tier are eligible to receive the 1-cent fraud-prevention adjustment allowance on top of the base interchange cap under Regulation II. Eligibility requires the issuer to meet the Federal Reserve's fraud-prevention standards annually.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.4; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: interchange_cap_ad_valorem_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interchange Cap Ad Valorem Rate (Basis Points)
attributes.description: Ad valorem (percentage-based) component of the Regulation II interchange cap expressed in basis points of the transaction value. Under the Federal Reserve rule, regulated issuers may charge up to 0.05% (5 basis points) of the transaction amount in addition to the fixed cent cap.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.3; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: interchange_cap_cents
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) Cap (Cents per Transaction)
attributes.description: Maximum allowable interchange fee in US cents per debit card transaction under Regulation II for this compliance tier. For regulated issuers, the Federal Reserve base cap is 21 cents plus 0.05% of the transaction value, with an optional 1-cent fraud-adjustment allowance. This field stores the fixed per-transaction cent component of the cap.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.3; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: issuer_asset_band
attributes.description: Categorical asset size band of the issuer population covered by this tier, used for segmentation and analytics. 'above_10b' corresponds to regulated issuers under Regulation II; bands below $10 billion are exempt. Supports revenue and cost-of-acceptance analysis by issuer size.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.5; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: issuer_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the issuer under Regulation II based on asset threshold and card program type. 'regulated' applies to issuers with consolidated assets ≥ $10 billion; 'exempt' covers small issuers below the threshold; 'government_administered' and 'reloadable_prepaid' reflect statutory exemptions under Regulation II Section 235.5.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR Part 235; CFPB

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compliance tier was last reviewed against current Federal Reserve Regulation II rules and issuer asset threshold data. Used to track compliance review cadence and identify tiers due for reassessment.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Internal Compliance Governance

attributes.name: merchant_routing_choice_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether merchants are permitted to exercise least-cost routing (LCR) or preferred network routing for transactions under this compliance tier, as required by Regulation II. True = merchant routing choice is enabled and enforced; False = routing is issuer-controlled.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.7; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: network_exclusivity_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether issuers in this tier comply with the Regulation II network exclusivity prohibition, which requires that each debit card be enabled on at least two unaffiliated payment networks (e.g., Visa and a PIN debit network). True = compliant; False = non-compliant or under review.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.7; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review of this tier against Federal Reserve Regulation II requirements and updated issuer asset threshold data. Supports proactive compliance management and audit scheduling.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Internal Compliance Governance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory context, internal compliance annotations, or exception documentation related to this compliance tier. Used by compliance officers to record interpretive guidance or Federal Reserve correspondence.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Internal Compliance Governance

attributes.name: pin_debit_routing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether PIN-authenticated debit routing must be offered as one of the two unaffiliated network options under Regulation II network exclusivity requirements for this compliance tier. Supports routing compliance validation.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment) 12 CFR 235.7; Federal Reserve Board

attributes.name: revenue_impact_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the financial impact of this compliance tier on the acquiring or issuing portfolio. 'revenue_generating' = tier enables interchange income above cost; 'cost_center' = tier results in net interchange cost; 'neutral' = break-even. Supports revenue recognition and cost-of-acceptance analysis in ERP – Oracle Financials.
attributes.references: ERP – Oracle Financials (Revenue Recognition); SOX – Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Federal Reserve System – Regulation II

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance tier applies to dual-message (signature debit, e.g., Visa/Mastercard), single-message (PIN debit, e.g., Interlink/STAR), or both routing architectures. Dual-message transactions are authorized and cleared separately; single-message transactions are authorized and cleared in one message per ISO 8583.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); ISO 8583; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: superseded_by_tier_code
attributes.description: Tier code of the compliance tier record that replaced this record when it was superseded. Null if this tier is currently active or was retired without a direct successor. Enables forward-chaining of tier version history for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); SOX – Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this compliance tier configuration (e.g., REG_TIER_1, EXEMPT_TIER_A). Used as the business-facing identifier in regulatory filings and interchange routing tables.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); ISO 8583

attributes.name: tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the compliance tier, including the regulatory basis, applicable issuer population, and interchange cap rationale. Supports audit and regulatory review.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment)

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the compliance tier (e.g., 'Regulated Issuer – Standard Cap', 'Small Issuer Exempt – Fraud Adjustment Eligible'). Used in reporting dashboards and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment)

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this compliance tier record. 'active' = currently in force; 'inactive' = no longer applicable; 'pending' = approved but not yet effective; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer tier version; 'under_review' = subject to Federal Reserve or internal compliance review.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Internal Compliance Governance

attributes.name: transaction_channel
attributes.description: Payment transaction channel to which this compliance tier's interchange cap and routing rules apply. Regulation II routing requirements may differ between card-present (POS/NFC) and card-not-present (e-commerce) environments.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this compliance tier record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect stale configurations and support incremental ETL processing in the Data Warehouse and Analytics Platform.
attributes.references: SOX – Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this compliance tier record, incremented each time the tier configuration is updated (e.g., cap amount change, routing rule update). Supports point-in-time compliance auditing and change history tracking.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System – Regulation II (Durbin Amendment); SOX – Sarbanes-Oxley Act

products.name: qualification
products.description: Transactional record of the interchange rate qualification outcome for each cleared transaction. Captures the transaction reference, qualified IRF category, rate applied, interchange amount calculated, downgrade reason (if applicable), qualifying criteria met (EMV, AVS, MCC, card-present flag), scheme identifier, and settlement currency. Feeds cost-of-acceptance reporting and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interchange qualification record. Primary key for this transactional record of interchange rate qualification outcome.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Qualification logic depends on card‑scheme specific rules stored in reference.

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.irf_rate_category. Business justification: interchange_qualification references qualified IRF category; adds irf_rate_category_id FK

attributes.name: mcc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.mcc. Business justification: MCC determines eligibility and rate tiers for interchange qualification.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant who accepted the transaction. Links to merchant management system for merchant-level interchange analysis and cost-of-acceptance reporting.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fx.fx_rate. Business justification: Regulatory interchange fee reporting requires the FX rate used to convert foreign‑currency transaction amounts to settlement currency.

attributes.name: risk_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_profile. Business justification: Pricing reports need merchant risk tier; linking qualification to risk_profile enables tier‑based fee calculations.

attributes.name: settlement_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to settlement.cycle. Business justification: Enables qualification data to be associated with the settlement cycle used in interchange fee calculations and audit trails.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cleared transaction for which interchange qualification was performed. Links to the transaction processing platform record.

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: Transaction type is required for rule‑based qualification and reporting.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: Unique 23-digit acquirer reference number assigned to the transaction by the acquiring bank. Used for transaction tracing across the payment network.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transaction was authorized. Time between authorization and settlement is a factor in interchange qualification.

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: Result code from address verification system check performed during authorization. AVS match is a qualifying criterion for many card-not-present interchange categories.

attributes.name: bin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Identification Number (BIN) / Issuer Identification Number (IIN)
attributes.description: First 6-8 digits of the card number identifying the issuing bank and card program. BIN-level interchange qualification rules determine which IRF category applies based on issuer and card product.

attributes.name: card_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was card-present (face-to-face) or card-not-present (e-commerce, mail order, phone order). Card-present transactions typically qualify for lower interchange rates.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Type of payment card used in the transaction. Card type is a primary factor in interchange qualification as different card types have different IRF schedules.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: contactless_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was processed using contactless NFC technology (tap-to-pay). Contactless transactions may qualify for specific interchange categories.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interchange qualification record was first created in the data platform. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction crossed international borders (acquiring country differs from issuing country). Cross-border transactions typically incur higher interchange rates and additional scheme fees.

attributes.name: cvv_result_code
attributes.description: Result code from CVV verification performed during authorization. CVV match is a qualifying criterion for card-not-present transactions to achieve optimal interchange rates.

attributes.name: downgrade_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the transaction was downgraded to a higher interchange rate category. Null if transaction qualified for optimal rate. Common reasons include missing AVS, non-EMV, delayed settlement, or missing Level 2/3 data.

attributes.name: downgrade_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of why the transaction was downgraded, providing detail on the specific qualification criteria that were not met.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction is subject to Durbin Amendment interchange rate caps (applies to debit cards issued by banks with $10B+ in assets in the United States). Durbin-regulated transactions have capped interchange rates.

attributes.name: emv_chip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was processed using EMV chip technology. EMV transactions typically qualify for preferential interchange rates due to enhanced security.

attributes.name: interchange_amount
attributes.description: The total calculated interchange fee amount for this transaction based on the qualified IRF rate and transaction amount. This is the fee paid from the acquiring bank to the issuing bank.

attributes.name: irf_fixed_amount
attributes.description: The fixed fee component of the qualified interchange fee applied to the transaction. Expressed in the settlement currency.
attributes.references: Visa Interchange Reimbursement Fees, Mastercard Interchange Programs

attributes.name: irf_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate component of the qualified interchange fee applied to the transaction amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0175 for 1.75%).
attributes.references: Visa Interchange Reimbursement Fees, Mastercard Interchange Programs

attributes.name: level_2_data_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Level 2 enhanced data (tax amount, customer code, etc.) was provided with the transaction. Level 2 data is required for commercial card interchange optimization.
attributes.references: Visa Commercial Solutions, Mastercard Business Solutions

attributes.name: level_3_data_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Level 3 line-item data (item descriptions, quantities, unit costs) was provided with the transaction. Level 3 data is required for optimal commercial and purchasing card interchange rates.
attributes.references: Visa Commercial Solutions, Mastercard Business Solutions

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the transaction qualified for the optimal interchange rate, was downgraded to a higher-cost tier, is exempt from interchange, or encountered an error during qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the interchange qualification process was executed and the IRF category was determined. Represents the business event time of qualification.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the interchange amount is settled between acquiring and issuing banks.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transaction was settled and interchange fees were calculated and transferred between acquiring and issuing banks. Delayed settlement can result in interchange downgrades.

attributes.name: three_ds_authentication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was authenticated using 3-D Secure protocol (Verified by Visa, Mastercard SecureCode). 3DS authentication is a qualifying criterion for e-commerce interchange optimization.
attributes.references: EMVCo 3-D Secure Specifications, PSD2 SCA Requirements

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount on which the interchange fee was calculated. Expressed in the transaction currency before any currency conversion.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction amount. May differ from settlement currency if cross-border transaction.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interchange qualification record was last modified. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

products.name: billing
products.description: Periodic interchange billing record representing the net interchange amount billed or credited between acquirer and issuer for a settlement period. Captures billing period, scheme identifier, acquiring bank, issuing bank, total transaction count, gross interchange amount, scheme fee deductions, net settlement amount, currency, and billing status. Supports reconciliation against scheme invoices.

attributes.name: billing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interchange billing record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: acquiring_bank_legal_entity_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Acquiring Bank Legal Entity Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Billing statements require linking the acquiring bank to its legal entity for settlement and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Billing entries require employee approval for audit and reconciliation; linking to employee enables traceability in financial controls.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Billing aggregation uses scheme identifier to pull scheme‑specific fee rules.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the acquiring bank (merchant's bank) in the interchange billing transaction.

attributes.name: issuing_bank_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the issuing bank (cardholder's bank) in the interchange billing transaction.

attributes.name: mcc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.mcc. Business justification: MCC classification is essential for billing adjustments and cross‑border fee calculations.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fx.fx_rate. Business justification: Billing statements must reference the FX rate applied to net settlement amounts for cross‑border billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: scheme_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.scheme_invoice. Business justification: Interchange billing records are associated with a scheme invoice; adds scheme_invoice_id FK

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: Transaction type drives billing logic for fee assessment and compliance.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustments applied to the interchange billing, including chargebacks, representments, or billing corrections from prior periods.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this interchange billing record was approved for settlement.

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interchange billing record indicating its processing state. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|PENDING|BILLED|SETTLED|DISPUTED|ADJUSTED|CANCELLED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bin
attributes.description: The Bank Identification Number or Issuer Identification Number (IIN) that identifies the issuing institution for the card transactions in this billing period.

attributes.name: card_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transactions in this billing were predominantly card-present (POS) or card-not-present (CNP) transactions, affecting interchange rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this interchange billing record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing includes cross-border transactions where the acquiring and issuing banks are in different countries, typically subject to higher interchange rates.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the interchange billing amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: cycle_identifier
attributes.description: A code or identifier representing the billing cycle frequency and sequence (e.g., monthly, weekly) for this interchange billing.

attributes.name: discrepancy_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference identified during reconciliation between the billed amount and expected amount, if any.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interchange billing is subject to Durbin Amendment interchange fee caps for regulated debit card transactions.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this interchange billing transaction was posted to the General Ledger in the ERP system.

attributes.name: gross_interchange_amount
attributes.description: The total gross Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) amount before any deductions or adjustments for the billing period.

attributes.name: interchange_qualification_tier
attributes.description: The interchange rate qualification tier applied to the transactions in this billing, determining the applicable IRF rate structure.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount to be settled between acquirer and issuer after all fees, adjustments, and deductions. This is the amount billed or credited.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this interchange billing record, including explanations for adjustments or discrepancies.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period for which interchange fees are calculated and billed.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period for which interchange fees are calculated and billed.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the reconciliation process comparing this billing record against the card scheme's invoice and internal transaction records.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or invoice number assigned by the card scheme or billing system for reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the interchange revenue or expense is recognized in the financial statements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: scheme_fee_amount
attributes.description: The total card scheme fees (network fees, assessment fees) deducted from the gross interchange amount.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net settlement amount is scheduled to be transferred between the acquiring and issuing banks.

attributes.name: total_transaction_count
attributes.description: The total number of transactions included in this interchange billing record for the specified period and parties.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this interchange billing record was last modified or updated.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: cost_of_acceptance
products.description: Calculated cost-of-acceptance record per merchant per settlement period, aggregating interchange fees, scheme assessment fees, and MSF components to derive the total payment acceptance cost. Stores gross transaction volume (TPV), total interchange cost, total scheme fees, total MSF revenue, net margin, effective rate (basis points), and period identifiers. Supports acquiring portfolio profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cost_of_acceptance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost of acceptance record.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant for whom this cost of acceptance is calculated.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: msf_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.msf_schedule. Business justification: cost_of_acceptance aggregates fees for a merchant schedule; adds msf_schedule_id FK

attributes.name: settlement_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement period during which these costs were incurred.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that approved the cost of acceptance calculation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cost of acceptance record was approved for finalization.

attributes.name: average_ticket_size
attributes.description: Average transaction amount calculated as gross transaction volume divided by transaction count.

attributes.name: bin_range_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct Bank Identification Number (BIN) or Issuer Identification Number (IIN) ranges represented in the transactions for this settlement period.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cost of acceptance calculation was performed.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The pricing model or calculation method used to determine the cost of acceptance for this merchant.

attributes.name: card_not_present_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume for card-not-present (CNP) transactions processed via e-commerce, mail order, or telephone order channels.

attributes.name: card_present_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume for card-present (CP) transactions processed via Point of Sale (POS) or mobile Point of Sale (mPOS) terminals.

attributes.name: chargeback_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume associated with chargebacks initiated during the settlement period, impacting net margin calculations.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Regulation E

attributes.name: cost_of_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost of acceptance record indicating its processing state.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost of acceptance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_card_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume processed using credit cards during the settlement period.

attributes.name: cross_border_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume for cross-border transactions where the issuing bank country differs from the acquiring bank country.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; SWIFT

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the cost of acceptance is denominated.

attributes.name: debit_card_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume processed using debit cards during the settlement period.
attributes.references: Regulation II Durbin Amendment; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: domestic_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume for domestic transactions where the issuing bank and acquiring bank are in the same country.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the merchant transactions are subject to Durbin Amendment interchange rate caps (True) or exempt (False).
attributes.references: Regulation II Durbin Amendment; Federal Reserve System

attributes.name: effective_rate_bps
attributes.description: Effective cost of acceptance rate expressed in basis points (bps), calculated as (total cost / gross transaction volume) * 10000.
attributes.references: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) Standards; Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: gross_transaction_volume
attributes.description: Total Payment Volume (TPV) representing the gross value of all transactions processed during the settlement period before any fees or deductions.

attributes.name: interchange_qualification_tier
attributes.description: The interchange qualification tier applied to the majority of transactions in this settlement period, determining the IRF rate structure.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Regulation II Durbin Amendment

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Four-digit Merchant Category Code (MCC) classifying the merchants business type, which influences interchange qualification and rates.
attributes.references: ISO 18245; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: mdr_percentage
attributes.description: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) percentage applied to the merchant for this settlement period, representing the total fee as a percentage of transaction volume.
attributes.references: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) Standards; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: net_margin
attributes.description: Net margin calculated as total MSF revenue minus total interchange cost and total scheme fees, representing the acquiring portfolio profitability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the cost of acceptance calculation, adjustments, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: refund_volume
attributes.description: Total transaction volume associated with refunds processed during the settlement period.

attributes.name: settlement_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the settlement period covered by this cost of acceptance record.

attributes.name: settlement_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the settlement period covered by this cost of acceptance record.

attributes.name: total_interchange_cost
attributes.description: Total Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) paid to issuing banks for all transactions during the settlement period.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Regulation II Durbin Amendment

attributes.name: total_msf_revenue
attributes.description: Total Merchant Service Fee (MSF) revenue collected from the merchant for payment processing services during the settlement period.

attributes.name: total_scheme_fees
attributes.description: Total assessment fees charged by card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) for network usage during the settlement period.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of transactions processed for the merchant during the settlement period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost of acceptance record was last modified.

products.name: downgrade
products.description: Records instances where a transaction failed to qualify for the optimal interchange rate category and was downgraded to a higher-cost tier. Captures original qualified category, downgraded-to category, downgrade reason code, rate differential (basis points), incremental cost, merchant identifier, transaction reference, and scheme. Enables downgrade root-cause analysis and merchant coaching.

attributes.name: downgrade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interchange downgrade event.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dispute.case. Business justification: During dispute resolution, downgrade details are needed to assess cost impact; linking downgrade to dispute case enables that process.

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.irf_rate_category. Business justification: interchange_downgrade references both original and downgraded IRF categories; adds irf_rate_category_id FK

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant whose transaction was downgraded.

attributes.name: risk_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_case. Business justification: Each downgrade may trigger a risk investigation; linking allows auditors to trace downgrade to its risk case.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction that experienced the interchange downgrade.

attributes.name: acquirer_reference_data
attributes.description: Additional reference data provided by the acquiring bank for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: Unique 23-digit reference number assigned by the acquiring bank to track the transaction across the payment network.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the transaction was authorized by the issuing bank.

attributes.name: avs_response_code
attributes.description: Code returned by the issuer indicating the result of address verification, which is often required for optimal interchange qualification.

attributes.name: bin
attributes.description: First 6-8 digits of the card number identifying the issuing bank and card product type.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the authorized transaction was captured for settlement.

attributes.name: card_present_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction was card-present (true) or card-not-present (false), which affects interchange qualification.

attributes.name: card_scheme
attributes.description: Payment network brand that processed the transaction and applied the downgrade.

attributes.name: card_tier
attributes.description: The card product tier or level (e.g., standard, rewards, premium, corporate) which influences interchange rates.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment card used in the transaction, which determines applicable interchange rate tables.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this downgrade record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: cvv_response_code
attributes.description: Code returned by the issuer indicating the result of CVV verification, which is often required for optimal interchange qualification in card-not-present transactions.

attributes.name: detected_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the interchange downgrade was identified and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: downgraded_irf_rate_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Downgraded Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) Rate in Basis Points
attributes.description: The actual interchange rate in basis points applied after the downgrade, representing a higher cost to the merchant.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction is subject to Durbin Amendment interchange rate caps for regulated debit cards.

attributes.name: emv_chip_transaction
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction used EMV chip technology, which typically qualifies for lower interchange rates.

attributes.name: incremental_cost_amount
attributes.description: The additional interchange fee cost incurred by the merchant due to the downgrade, calculated as the rate differential applied to the transaction amount.

attributes.name: incremental_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the incremental cost amount.

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Four-digit code classifying the merchant's type of business, which influences interchange qualification rules.

attributes.name: merchant_processing_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the transaction was processed, affecting interchange qualification criteria.

attributes.name: original_irf_rate_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) Rate in Basis Points
attributes.description: The optimal interchange rate in basis points that would have applied if the transaction had not been downgraded.

attributes.name: preventable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downgrade could have been prevented through merchant action or system configuration changes.

attributes.name: rate_differential_bps
attributes.description: The difference in basis points between the downgraded rate and the original qualified rate, representing the incremental cost penalty.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for the interchange downgrade, such as missing AVS data, late settlement, or incomplete transaction data.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of why the transaction was downgraded, providing context for merchant coaching and remediation.

attributes.name: remediation_action_recommended
attributes.description: Suggested corrective action for the merchant to prevent future downgrades of this type, used for merchant coaching and optimization.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transaction was settled and the downgrade was applied during clearing.

attributes.name: settlement_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of days between authorization and settlement, where excessive delay can trigger interchange downgrades.

attributes.name: three_ds_authentication_status
attributes.description: Status of 3-D Secure authentication for the transaction, which can affect interchange qualification for e-commerce transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount in the transaction currency on which the interchange fees are calculated.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original transaction was authorized or processed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this downgrade record was last modified in the data platform.

products.name: scheme_invoice
products.description: Card scheme invoice record representing the periodic billing statement received from Visa, Mastercard, Amex, or Discover for network participation fees, assessment fees, and scheme services. Captures invoice number, scheme identifier, billing period, invoice date, due date, line-item fee categories, total amount due, currency, payment status, and reconciliation reference. SSOT for scheme payables.

attributes.name: scheme_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the card scheme invoice record. Primary key for the scheme invoice entity.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Invoice generation requires linking to the card scheme for correct fee line items.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for audit trail linking each invoice creation to the responsible employee, needed for PCI DSS and internal compliance reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dispute.case. Business justification: Regulatory reporting and reconciliation require associating a scheme invoice with the dispute case that challenges its amounts.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
