attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Required for GL posting of scheme invoices; financial reporting mandates linking each invoice to its GL account.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fx.fx_rate. Business justification: Scheme invoices may be issued in various currencies; linking to the FX rate enables accurate accounting and audit of converted totals.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires each scheme invoice to reference the governing regulatory obligation for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: settlement_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to settlement.cycle. Business justification: Links scheme invoices to the settlement cycle they belong to, supporting regulatory reporting of scheme fees per cycle.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net amount of credits, refunds, or additional charges applied to this invoice as adjustments from prior billing periods or corrections. Positive values represent additional charges; negative values represent credits.

attributes.name: assessment_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing assessment fees charged by the card scheme based on transaction volume or value. Typically calculated as a percentage of Total Payment Volume (TPV) or Gross Merchandise Value (GMV).

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the billing period covered by this scheme invoice. Defines the end of the time window for which fees and assessments are being charged.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the billing period covered by this scheme invoice. Defines the beginning of the time window for which fees and assessments are being charged.

attributes.name: chargeback_processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing fees charged by the card scheme for processing chargebacks and disputes during the billing period. Includes fees for dispute lifecycle management and arbitration services.

attributes.name: compliance_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing penalties or fines assessed by the card scheme for non-compliance with network rules, PCI DSS requirements, or other regulatory standards. Zero if no penalties were assessed.
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council, Card Scheme Compliance Rules

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center or business unit code responsible for this scheme invoice expense. Used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this scheme invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cross_border_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing fees charged for cross-border or international transactions where the issuing bank and acquiring bank are in different countries or regions.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The date on which this invoice was formally disputed with the card scheme. Null if invoice has not been disputed.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code provided if this invoice is disputed. Indicates the nature of the dispute (e.g., incorrect fee calculation, unrecognized charges, billing error). Null if invoice is not disputed.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dispute for this invoice was resolved. Null if dispute is still open or if invoice was never disputed.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be received by the card scheme to avoid late fees or penalties. Defines the payment deadline for this invoice.

attributes.name: interchange_reimbursement_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing Interchange Reimbursement Fees (IRF) paid between acquiring and issuing banks through the card scheme. This is the fee paid by the acquiring bank to the issuing bank for each transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this scheme invoice is denominated. All monetary amounts on this invoice are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the card scheme issued this invoice. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the billing statement was generated and sent.

attributes.name: invoice_document_url
attributes.description: The URL or file path to the original invoice document (PDF or other format) provided by the card scheme. Used for audit trail and detailed line-item review.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique invoice number assigned by the card scheme (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover) for this billing statement. This is the business identifier used for reconciliation and payment reference.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scheme invoice indicating its payment and processing state. Tracks the invoice from issuance through payment completion or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: network_participation_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing fees charged for participation in the card scheme network. This is a recurring membership or access fee for being part of the payment network.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this scheme invoice, including special instructions, dispute details, or reconciliation observations. Used for operational communication and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was made to the card scheme for this invoice. Null if invoice remains unpaid.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used to settle this scheme invoice. Indicates how the payment was made to the card scheme.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number or transaction identifier for the payment made to settle this invoice. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail. Null if invoice is unpaid.

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier linking this scheme invoice to the internal reconciliation record or general ledger entry. Used to track the invoice through the accounts payable and financial close process.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the reconciliation process for this scheme invoice, indicating whether the invoice has been matched to internal transaction records and general ledger entries.

attributes.name: scheme_service_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice representing fees for specific card scheme services such as tokenization, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, or other value-added services provided by the network.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of taxes (VAT, GST, sales tax, or other applicable taxes) applied to this scheme invoice. Zero if no taxes are applicable.

attributes.name: total_amount_due
attributes.description: The total amount payable to the card scheme for this invoice, representing the sum of all line-item fees, assessments, and charges. This is the net total amount due before any adjustments or credits.

attributes.name: transaction_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of all transactions processed through the card scheme network during the billing period, expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the Total Payment Volume (TPV) or Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for fee calculation purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_volume
attributes.description: The total number of transactions processed through the card scheme network during the billing period covered by this invoice. Used to validate volume-based fee calculations.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this scheme invoice record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this scheme invoice record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: scheme_invoice_line
products.description: Line-item detail of a card scheme invoice, breaking down each fee component billed by the scheme. Captures fee type code, fee description, transaction volume basis, rate applied, calculated amount, currency, and the parent scheme invoice reference. Enables granular reconciliation of scheme fees against internal transaction volumes and interchange qualification records.

attributes.name: scheme_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the scheme invoice line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the finance team member who approved this fee line for payment. Null until approval is granted. Used for segregation of duties controls and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispute case if this fee line is under dispute with the card scheme. Links to the dispute management system for tracking dispute lifecycle, evidence submission, and resolution. Null when no dispute exists.
attributes.references: Internal Dispute Management Standards, Card Scheme Dispute Procedures

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the finance team member who approved this fee line for payment. Null until approval is granted. Used for segregation of duties controls and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Each fee line must be posted to a specific GL account for accurate financial statements and audit trails.

attributes.name: original_invoice_line_scheme_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original scheme_invoice_line_id that this adjustment line is correcting. Null for original fee charges. Used to trace adjustment history and maintain audit trail for billing corrections.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Standards, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: scheme_fee_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.scheme_fee_table. Business justification: scheme_invoice_line details a fee defined in scheme_fee_table; adds scheme_fee_table_id FK

attributes.name: scheme_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent scheme invoice that this line item belongs to. Links line-level detail to the invoice header for reconciliation and aggregation.

attributes.name: adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents an adjustment or correction to a previously billed fee. True for adjustments, credits, or corrections; false for original fee charges. Used to track billing accuracy and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for an adjustment when adjustment_indicator is true. Examples include billing error correction, rate change retroactive application, volume correction, or dispute resolution credit. Null for non-adjustment lines.
attributes.references: Internal Finance Standards, Card Scheme Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fee line was approved for payment by the finance team. Null until approval is granted. Used for payment processing workflow and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Finance Standards

attributes.name: authorization_method
attributes.description: Method by which transactions were authorized. EMV chip, contactless NFC, magnetic stripe, manual key entry, ecommerce, recurring billing, or mail-order/telephone-order (MOTO). Interchange rates and fraud liability vary by authorization method. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chip|contactless|magnetic_stripe|manual|ecommerce|recurring|moto — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EMVCo Standards, PCI DSS, Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this fee is billed. All monetary amounts on this line (transaction_value_basis, fee_amount) are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: bin_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of the BIN or IIN range that this fee line applies to. Used in conjunction with bin_range_low to define the card portfolio segment for this fee calculation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812, EMVCo Standards, Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: bin_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of the BIN or IIN (Issuer Identification Number) range that this fee line applies to. Used for BIN-level interchange qualification and fee segmentation. First 6-8 digits of the card number identifying the issuing bank.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7812, EMVCo Standards, Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: card_product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the card product that this fee applies to. Interchange rates and scheme fees vary significantly by card product type. Examples include consumer credit, consumer debit, commercial cards, and premium card tiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit|debit|prepaid|commercial|rewards|signature|platinum|world|world_elite — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Standards, EMVCo

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or business unit code for allocating this fee expense. Used for management accounting, profitability analysis, and internal chargeback to business lines or product portfolios.
attributes.references: Internal Finance Standards, ERP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scheme invoice line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Standards, Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: cross_border_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee line applies to cross-border transactions (issuer and acquirer in different countries). Cross-border transactions typically incur additional scheme fees and higher interchange rates.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, PSD2

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee line applies to transactions subject to Durbin Amendment interchange caps (US Regulation II). Durbin-regulated debit transactions from large issuers have capped interchange rates. Critical for US market compliance and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation II (Durbin Amendment), Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert settlement_currency_code amounts to billing_currency_code amounts. Null when billing and settlement currencies are the same. Used for cross-border fee reconciliation and dynamic currency conversion (DCC) scenarios.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Calculated fee amount for this line item in the billing currency. Represents the actual charge from the card scheme for this specific fee component. This is the primary financial value used for reconciliation and accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: fee_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the fee for reporting and cost allocation. Groups related fee types into business-meaningful categories for financial analysis and revenue recognition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: interchange|assessment|network|authorization|cross_border|chargeback|dispute|service|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Finance Standards, Card Scheme Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fee type and its business purpose. Provides context for the fee_type_code, explaining what service or transaction activity triggered this charge.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Standards

attributes.name: fee_rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to calculate this fee. May represent a percentage (e.g., 0.015 for 1.5%), a per-transaction amount, or a tiered rate depending on fee_rate_type. Used in conjunction with transaction_volume_basis or transaction_value_basis to compute fee_amount.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Standards

attributes.name: fee_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the fee_rate should be interpreted and applied. Percentage rates are applied to transaction_value_basis, per-transaction rates are multiplied by transaction_volume_basis, tiered rates vary by volume thresholds, flat rates are fixed amounts, and basis points represent hundredths of a percent.
attributes.references: Internal Finance Standards, Card Scheme Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: fee_type_code
attributes.description: Card scheme-specific code identifying the type of fee being charged. Examples include interchange reimbursement fees (IRF), assessment fees, network fees, authorization fees, cross-border fees, and scheme service fees. Aligns with Visa and Mastercard fee code taxonomies.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, ISO 20022

attributes.name: interchange_qualification_tier
attributes.description: Specific interchange qualification tier or program that this fee line is associated with. Examples include CPS/Retail, CPS/Card Not Present, EIRF, Standard, or scheme-specific tier names. Determines the applicable interchange reimbursement fee (IRF) rate.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules, Mastercard Standards

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent scheme invoice. Used for ordering and referencing specific line items in reconciliation and dispute processes.

attributes.name: merchant_category_code
attributes.description: Four-digit ISO 18245 code classifying the type of merchant or business where transactions occurred. Interchange qualification and fee structures often vary by MCC. Used for industry-specific fee segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 18245, Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or context about this fee line. Used by finance and operations teams to document unusual circumstances, reconciliation findings, or dispute rationale.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the payment transaction used to settle this fee line with the card scheme. Links to accounts payable payment records and bank statements. Null until payment is executed.
attributes.references: SWIFT Standards, ACH Rules, Internal Treasury Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reconciliation process for this fee line. Tracks whether the scheme-billed fee has been matched against internal transaction records, whether variances exist, and whether the line has been approved for payment.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: service_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period that this fee line covers. Defines the end of the transaction activity window used to calculate this fee. Used for period-based reconciliation and revenue recognition cutoff.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Standards, Internal Billing Standards

attributes.name: service_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period that this fee line covers. Defines the beginning of the transaction activity window used to calculate this fee. Used for period-based reconciliation and accrual accounting.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Standards, Internal Billing Standards

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code

products.name: revenue_recognition_entry

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition entries need a GL account reference for journal posting and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchant for whom revenue is being recognized. Links to the merchant master entity.

attributes.name: original_entry_revenue_recognition_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original revenue recognition entry if this entry is an adjustment or reversal (null for original entries).

attributes.name: rate_id

attributes.name: scheme_invoice_id

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the settlement batch that generated this revenue recognition entry.

attributes.name: settlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to settlement.settlement. Business justification: Connects revenue recognition entries to the master settlement record for consolidated financial reporting and GL posting.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) to which this revenue recognition entry is posted.

attributes.name: adjustment_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for any adjustment or reversal applied to this entry.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any adjustment or reversal applied to this revenue recognition entry (null if no adjustment).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition entry record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the revenue amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: deferred_amount
attributes.description: The portion of gross revenue that is deferred to future periods under revenue recognition rules.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this revenue entry is subject to Durbin Amendment interchange rate caps (applies to regulated debit card transactions).

attributes.name: erp_batch_reference
attributes.description: The batch identifier in the ERP system (Oracle Financials) to which this revenue recognition entry was posted.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross revenue amount before any deferrals or adjustments.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: interchange_rate_applied
attributes.description: The effective interchange rate (as a decimal) applied to calculate the interchange income component of this entry.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition entry record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: mdr_rate_applied
attributes.description: The effective Merchant Discount Rate (as a decimal) applied to calculate the MSF income component of this entry.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue amount after deducting scheme fees and other pass-through costs from recognized revenue.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context or audit trail information for this revenue recognition entry.

attributes.name: posted_to_gl_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition entry was posted to the General Ledger system.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code representing the product line or service category for which revenue is recognized (e.g., acquiring, issuing, gateway services).

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue is recognized in accordance with ASC 606 revenue recognition principles.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the revenue recognition entry in the accounting workflow: pending, recognized, adjusted, reversed, or finalized.

attributes.name: recognized_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue amount recognized in the current period (gross_amount minus deferred_amount).

attributes.name: revenue_share_amount
attributes.description: The absolute revenue amount shared with the partner, calculated from recognized_amount and revenue_share_percentage.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage

attributes.name: revenue_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue type being recognized: interchange income, Merchant Service Fee (MSF) income, scheme fee pass-through, gateway fee, processing fee, or other.

attributes.name: scheme_fee_amount

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date

attributes.name: sox_control_flag

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: The number of transactions that contributed to this revenue recognition entry within the settlement period.

products.name: rate_history

attributes.name: currency_pair_id

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id

attributes.name: transaction_min_amount

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The type of transaction this interchange rate applies to (purchase, cash advance, balance transfer, refund).

attributes.description: Timestamp when this interchange rate history record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the interchange income is posted.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interchange income was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: gross_interchange_earned
attributes.description: Total gross interchange revenue earned by the issuer before any deductions or fees.

attributes.name: interchange_qualification_tier
attributes.description: Interchange rate tier or category that the transactions qualified for (e.g., standard, enhanced, premium).

attributes.name: issuer_bin
attributes.description: Bank Identification Number or Issuer Identification Number (IIN) representing the issuer's card range.

attributes.name: issuer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the issuing bank or financial institution.

attributes.name: net_interchange_income
attributes.description: Net interchange income after all scheme fees, processing fees, and adjustments have been deducted from gross interchange.

attributes.name: network_assessment_fee
attributes.description: Assessment fee charged by the card network for transaction processing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this interchange income record, including any special circumstances or exceptions.

attributes.name: portfolio_segment
attributes.description: Issuer portfolio segment or business line (e.g., consumer, commercial, small business, premium).

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Processing fees deducted from interchange income for transaction handling and settlement services.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of reconciliation between issuer records and scheme settlement reports.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for the issuer (e.g., EMEA, APAC, LATAM, North America).

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interchange income is recognized as revenue for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: scheme_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fees charged by the card scheme (network fees, assessment fees) deducted from gross interchange.

attributes.name: scheme_settlement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number provided by the card scheme for this settlement period.

attributes.name: settlement_cycle_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the settlement cycle or batch (e.g., monthly, weekly cycle code).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interchange income was settled to the issuer's account.

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the settlement period for which interchange income is calculated.

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the settlement period for which interchange income is calculated.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the interchange income settlement (e.g., pending, settled, reconciled, disputed).

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of transactions contributing to the interchange income for this settlement period.

attributes.name: transaction_volume
attributes.description: Total monetary volume of transactions processed during the settlement period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interchange income record was last updated.

products.name: interchange_reconciliation
products.description: Reconciliation record matching internal interchange qualification records against scheme-reported interchange amounts for a given settlement period. Captures settlement period, scheme identifier, internal calculated interchange, scheme-reported interchange, variance amount, variance percentage, reconciliation status (matched, unmatched, disputed), and resolution notes. Critical for financial close and scheme dispute management.

attributes.name: interchange_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the interchange reconciliation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: acquirer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the acquiring bank (merchant's bank) involved in the interchange transactions.

attributes.name: acquiring_bank_legal_entity_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Acquiring Bank Legal Entity Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Reconciliation reports must reference the acquiring bank's legal entity to resolve variance and audit discrepancies.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or manager who approved the reconciliation results and any adjustments.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispute case opened with the card scheme if the variance could not be internally resolved.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or analyst who performed the reconciliation and investigation.

attributes.name: issuing_bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issuing bank (cardholder's bank) involved in the interchange transactions.

attributes.name: primary_interchange_ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the acquiring bank (merchant's bank) involved in the interchange transactions.

attributes.name: primary_interchange_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or analyst who performed the reconciliation and investigation.

attributes.name: scheme_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.scheme_invoice. Business justification: Interchange reconciliation aligns with a scheme invoice; adds scheme_invoice_id FK

attributes.name: settlement_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the settlement period during which the interchange transactions occurred.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustment amount applied to reconcile the variance, either credited or debited based on dispute resolution.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for any adjustment applied to this reconciliation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reconciliation was approved by the authorized supervisor.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this reconciliation record.

attributes.name: cycle_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the reconciliation cycle or batch run during which this record was processed.

attributes.name: dispute_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal dispute was filed with the card scheme regarding this reconciliation variance.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the scheme dispute was resolved and final settlement amounts were agreed.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which interchange reconciliation amounts are posted.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation results and any adjustments were posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: internal_calculated_interchange_amount
attributes.description: The total interchange amount calculated internally based on qualification rules and transaction data for the settlement period.

attributes.name: internal_settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which internal settlement processing was completed for this period.

attributes.name: reconciled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reconciliation was completed and status was finalized.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reconciliation record indicating whether internal and scheme amounts are aligned.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this reconciliation record for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the investigation, resolution actions taken, and final outcome for this reconciliation record.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue or cost associated with this interchange reconciliation is recognized for financial reporting.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified for any variance in this reconciliation.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause identified for the variance, including specific transaction or rule issues.

attributes.name: scheme_identifier
attributes.description: The payment card scheme (network brand) for which this reconciliation is performed.

attributes.name: scheme_reported_interchange_amount
attributes.description: The total interchange amount reported by the card scheme for the same settlement period.

attributes.name: scheme_settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the card scheme settled the interchange amounts.

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the settlement period covered by this reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the settlement period covered by this reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_count_internal
attributes.description: The total number of transactions included in the internal interchange calculation for this period.

attributes.name: transaction_count_scheme
attributes.description: The total number of transactions reported by the card scheme for this period.

attributes.name: transaction_count_variance
attributes.description: The difference in transaction counts between internal records and scheme reports.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation record was last modified.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between internal calculated interchange and scheme reported interchange (internal minus scheme).

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the scheme reported interchange amount.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary threshold above which variances must be investigated and resolved.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variance amount or percentage exceeds the acceptable tolerance threshold requiring investigation.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage threshold above which variances must be investigated and resolved.

products.name: payfac_sub_merchant_pricing
products.description: Sub-merchant pricing configuration managed by a Payment Facilitator (PayFac) for each sub-merchant onboarded under its master MID. Captures sub-merchant identifier, PayFac identifier, pricing model (flat rate, tiered, IC-plus), applicable rate, per-transaction fee, monthly fee, volume cap, and effective date. Enables PayFac revenue split and interchange cost allocation to sub-merchants.

attributes.name: payfac_sub_merchant_pricing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the PayFac sub-merchant pricing configuration record.

attributes.name: acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.acquiring_portfolio_pricing. Business justification: PayFac sub‑merchant pricing belongs to a portfolio pricing configuration; adds acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id FK

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that approved this pricing configuration for activation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that approved this pricing configuration for activation.

attributes.name: payfac_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Payment Facilitator managing this sub-merchant pricing configuration.
attributes.references: Payment Facilitator Model - Card Scheme Rules

attributes.name: sub_merchant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sub-merchant onboarded under the PayFac master Merchant Identification Number (MID). This sub-merchant operates under the PayFac umbrella for payment processing.
attributes.references: Payment Facilitator Model - Card Scheme Rules

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing configuration was approved and authorized for use.

attributes.name: base_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The base percentage rate applied to transaction volume under this pricing configuration. For interchange-plus models, this represents the markup over interchange; for flat-rate models, this is the total rate charged.

attributes.name: batch_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged per batch settlement submission. Applicable when sub-merchant submits transaction batches for clearing and settlement.

attributes.name: card_type_tier
attributes.description: Specifies which card types this pricing configuration applies to. Enables differential pricing based on card product type (debit, credit, premium, commercial).

attributes.name: chargeback_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to the sub-merchant for each chargeback dispute processed, covering administrative and operational costs of dispute management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all fees and rates are denominated for this pricing configuration.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing configuration applies Durbin Amendment regulated debit interchange rates (True) or standard rates (False). Applicable to US debit card transactions from regulated issuers.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this pricing configuration expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended configuration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this pricing configuration becomes active and applicable to the sub-merchant transactions.

attributes.name: interchange_pass_through_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether actual interchange costs are passed through to the sub-merchant (True) or absorbed into blended pricing (False). Critical for interchange-plus pricing models.

attributes.name: mcc_restriction_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Merchant Category Codes (MCC) to which this pricing applies or is restricted. Used to enforce industry-specific pricing or risk controls.

attributes.name: monthly_fee
attributes.description: Fixed monthly service fee charged to the sub-merchant for account maintenance, platform access, and support services.

attributes.name: monthly_minimum_fee
attributes.description: Minimum monthly fee threshold. If calculated fees fall below this amount, the sub-merchant is charged the minimum to ensure baseline revenue.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special terms, exceptions, or operational notes related to this pricing configuration.

attributes.name: per_transaction_fee
attributes.description: Fixed fee charged per transaction processed for this sub-merchant, regardless of transaction amount. Typically expressed in the settlement currency.

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the legal or commercial agreement governing this pricing configuration. Links pricing to contractual terms.

attributes.name: pricing_configuration_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned code or identifier for this specific pricing configuration, used for internal reference and reporting.

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: The pricing model applied to the sub-merchant. Flat rate applies a single percentage to all transactions; tiered applies different rates based on card type or volume; interchange-plus (IC-plus) passes through interchange costs plus a markup; blended combines multiple fee components into a single rate; subscription charges a fixed periodic fee; custom represents bespoke pricing arrangements.

attributes.name: pricing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing configuration. Draft indicates pending approval; active indicates in use; suspended indicates temporarily inactive; expired indicates past effective end date; terminated indicates permanently closed.

attributes.name: pricing_tier_level
attributes.description: Named tier or level within a tiered pricing structure (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Used for volume-based or relationship-based pricing differentiation.

attributes.name: refund_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to the sub-merchant for processing refund transactions. May be waived or reduced depending on pricing tier.

attributes.name: revenue_split_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue (after interchange and scheme fees) retained by the PayFac. The remainder is the sub-merchant net settlement. Used for internal revenue allocation and partner reporting.

attributes.name: risk_reserve_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction volume withheld as a rolling reserve to cover potential chargebacks, refunds, or fraud losses. Released to sub-merchant after a defined holding period.

attributes.name: scheme_fee_pass_through_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether card scheme fees (Visa, Mastercard network fees) are passed through to the sub-merchant (True) or included in the pricing (False).

attributes.name: settlement_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of days between transaction authorization and funds settlement to the sub-merchant. Used for risk management and cash flow control.

attributes.name: transaction_count_cap
attributes.description: Maximum number of transactions allowed per month under this pricing configuration. Used for volume-based pricing tier enforcement.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing configuration record was last modified.

attributes.name: volume_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction volume allowed per month under this pricing configuration. Exceeding this cap may trigger pricing tier changes or require approval.

products.name: program
products.description: Card scheme interchange program master defining special interchange programs (e.g., Visa Utility, Mastercard Merit, Amex OptBlue, Visa Purchasing) with their eligibility criteria, qualifying transaction attributes, rate structures, and enrollment requirements. Captures program code, program name, scheme, card type eligibility, MCC eligibility, transaction size thresholds, and program tier levels.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the interchange program.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Program approval must be signed off by a designated employee; this link supports compliance reporting and program governance.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Program eligibility and rate structures must comply with specific regulatory obligations; linking enables compliance checks and reporting.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: True if enrollment into the program requires manual approval.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the program was approved for activation.

attributes.name: card_not_present_eligible_flag
attributes.description: True if card‑not‑present (e‑commerce) transactions are eligible.

attributes.name: card_present_eligible_flag
attributes.description: True if card‑present (in‑store) transactions are eligible.

attributes.name: card_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Card types that qualify for the program.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Internal code categorizing the program (e.g., Utility, Merit, Purchasing).

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Regulatory or compliance related observations for the program (e.g., PCI DSS, PSD2).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_eligible_flag
attributes.description: True if transactions crossing national borders qualify for the program.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for monetary values in the program.

attributes.name: data_quality_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the confidence level of the program data.

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program is subject to the Durbin Amendment regulations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the program expires or is superseded. Null if open‑ended.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the program becomes effective.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria_description
attributes.description: Detailed rules that determine transaction qualification for the program.

attributes.name: enrollment_requirements
attributes.description: Textual description of the criteria a merchant or issuer must satisfy to enroll in the program.

attributes.name: fixed_fee_amount
attributes.description: Flat fee amount charged per transaction under this program.

attributes.name: installment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: True if installment‑based transactions qualify.

attributes.name: mcc_eligibility
attributes.description: Merchant category codes (MCC) that are eligible for the program. Multiple codes may be stored as a delimited list.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or internal remarks about the program.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: External code used to identify the interchange program in scheme documentation.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the interchange program.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interchange program.

attributes.name: qualification_criteria_code
attributes.description: Code referencing a detailed rule set that defines qualification logic.

attributes.name: rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction amount charged as interchange under this program.

attributes.name: rate_structure_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program uses a percentage rate, a fixed fee, or a combination.

attributes.name: recurring_eligible_flag
attributes.description: True if recurring (subscription) transactions qualify.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Payment network that defines the program.

attributes.name: scheme_bulletin_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the scheme bulletin that announced the program.

attributes.name: scheme_publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the scheme published the program details.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated the program record (e.g., Merchant Management System).

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Tier classification that determines rate structure.

attributes.name: tokenization_eligible_flag
attributes.description: True if tokenized card transactions are eligible under the program.

attributes.name: transaction_amount_max
attributes.description: Upper bound of transaction amount for eligibility.

attributes.name: transaction_amount_min
attributes.description: Lower bound of transaction amount (in program currency) for eligibility.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the program record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version of the program definition, incremented on each change.

products.name: cross_border_fee_rule
products.description: Cross-border and international transaction fee rules defining the additional fees applied when the issuing country differs from the acquiring country. Captures originating country, destination country, card scheme, cross-border assessment rate, currency conversion fee rate, DCC (Dynamic Currency Conversion) fee, SWIFT/correspondent banking fee component, and effective date range. Supports FX cost modeling in cross-border payment flows.

attributes.name: cross_border_fee_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cross-border fee rule record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.acquiring_portfolio_pricing. Business justification: Cross‑border fee rules are defined within a portfolio pricing configuration; adds acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id FK

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the card scheme (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) to which this cross-border fee rule applies.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_cross_border_fee_rule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Cross-Border Fee Rule Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Reference to the cross-border fee rule that replaces this rule when it is superseded. Supports rule lineage and historical analysis.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: The payment card brand to which this cross-border fee rule applies. Determines which network rules govern the transaction.

attributes.name: card_present_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cross-border fee rule applies to card-present transactions (physical POS) or card-not-present transactions (e-commerce, MOTO).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cross-border fee rule record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: cross_border_assessment_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage-based cross-border assessment fee applied to the transaction amount when the issuing country differs from the acquiring country. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 1.25000 for 1.25%).

attributes.name: cross_border_fixed_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary fee applied per cross-border transaction, independent of transaction amount. Used in conjunction with or as an alternative to percentage-based fees.

attributes.name: currency_conversion_fee_rate_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Currency Conversion Fee Rate Percentage (Foreign Exchange - FX)
attributes.description: Percentage-based fee applied when currency conversion occurs in a cross-border transaction. Represents the FX markup over the wholesale exchange rate.
attributes.references: ISO 20022 Financial Messaging; Internal FX Policy

attributes.name: dcc_fee_rate_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) Fee Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Fee rate applied when Dynamic Currency Conversion is offered at the point of sale, allowing the cardholder to see the transaction amount in their home currency.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the destination country (typically the issuing country or cardholder country of residence).

attributes.name: destination_region_code
attributes.description: Regional grouping code for the destination country used for regional cross-border fee structures and compliance segmentation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this cross-border fee rule is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cross-border fee rule becomes active and applicable to qualifying transactions. Part of the temporal validity window.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the cross-border fees are denominated and assessed.

attributes.name: mcc_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of four-digit MCC codes to which this cross-border fee rule applies or excludes, based on the MCC restriction type.

attributes.name: mcc_restriction_type
attributes.description: Defines how the MCC list is applied: all (applies to all MCCs), include (applies only to listed MCCs), exclude (applies to all except listed MCCs).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special conditions, or operational notes related to this cross-border fee rule configuration.

attributes.name: originating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the transaction originates (typically the acquiring country or merchant location country).

attributes.name: originating_region_code
attributes.description: Regional grouping code for the originating country (e.g., EEA, NAFTA, APAC) used for regional cross-border fee structures.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple cross-border fee rules match a transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cross-border fee rule is subject to specific regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., PSD2 in EU, Durbin Amendment caps).

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory framework or jurisdiction-specific regulation governing this cross-border fee rule (e.g., PSD2, Regulation II, local central bank rules).
attributes.references: PSD2; Federal Reserve Regulation II; ECB Payment System Oversight

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business-readable unique code identifying this cross-border fee rule configuration. Used for operational reference and configuration management.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the cross-border fee rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cross-border fee rule. Controls whether the rule is applied in production fee calculation processes.

attributes.name: scheme_bulletin_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the official card scheme bulletin or publication that announced or mandated this cross-border fee rule.

attributes.name: scheme_program_code
attributes.description: Specific card scheme program or product identifier (e.g., Visa Signature, Mastercard World Elite) to which this cross-border fee rule applies.
attributes.references: Visa Product and Service Rules; Mastercard Standards

attributes.name: swift_correspondent_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee component for SWIFT messaging and correspondent banking services used in cross-border settlement. Applies when international wire transfers are required for settlement.

attributes.name: transaction_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount threshold for this cross-border fee rule to apply. Transactions above this amount may be subject to different fee structures or caps.

attributes.name: transaction_min_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount threshold for this cross-border fee rule to apply. Transactions below this amount may be subject to different fee structures.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of payment transaction to which this cross-border fee rule applies. Different transaction types may have different cross-border fee structures.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this cross-border fee rule record. Supports change management and audit requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cross-border fee rule record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this cross-border fee rule configuration. Incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this cross-border fee rule record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Compliance

products.name: pricing_exception
products.description: Records negotiated pricing exceptions and custom interchange arrangements granted to specific merchants, portfolios, or partners that deviate from standard MDR or MSF schedules. Captures exception type, merchant or portfolio identifier, standard rate, exception rate, basis point discount, approval authority, effective date, expiry date, and business justification. Supports audit and contract compliance tracking.

attributes.name: pricing_exception_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pricing exception record. Primary key for the pricing exception entity.

attributes.name: acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.acquiring_portfolio_pricing. Business justification: pricing_exception applies to a specific portfolio pricing configuration; adds acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id FK

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the user who approved this pricing exception. Links to user or employee master record.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the partner organization (ISO, PayFac, aggregator) to which this exception applies. Used when exceptions are negotiated at partner level.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the user who approved this pricing exception. Links to user or employee master record.

attributes.name: mdr_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.mdr_config. Business justification: pricing_exception is tied to an MDR configuration; adds mdr_config_id FK

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant receiving the pricing exception. Links to the merchant master record.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the merchant portfolio or segment to which this exception applies. Used when exceptions are granted at portfolio level rather than individual merchant level.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the executive or committee that authorized this pricing exception (e.g., Chief Revenue Officer, Pricing Committee, Regional VP).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing exception was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing exception automatically renews at the end of its term. True means exception continues unless terminated, false means it expires on effective_end_date.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the business rationale for granting this exception, including competitive factors, strategic value, volume commitments, or relationship considerations.

attributes.name: card_scheme
attributes.description: The payment card network to which this exception applies. Value 'all' indicates exception applies across all schemes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|amex|discover|jcb|unionpay|all — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: The card product type to which this exception applies. Value 'all' indicates exception applies to all card types.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance review of this exception to ensure it meets regulatory requirements, internal policy, and audit standards.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number of the merchant processing agreement, partner contract, or amendment that documents this pricing exception.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this pricing exception record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing exception expires. Null for open-ended exceptions subject to contract termination only.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pricing exception becomes active and applicable to qualifying transactions.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying this pricing exception for reference in contracts, invoices, and reporting.

attributes.name: exception_fixed_fee_amount
attributes.description: The negotiated per-transaction fixed fee granted under this exception. May be zero for full waiver.

attributes.name: exception_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the pricing exception, typically referencing the merchant, partner, or program name.

attributes.name: exception_rate_percent
attributes.description: The negotiated exception rate granted to the merchant, portfolio, or partner. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0225 for 2.25%).

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing exception. Draft is under construction, pending_approval awaits authorization, active is in force, suspended is temporarily inactive, expired has passed end date, terminated was cancelled before expiry.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Category of pricing exception granted. MDR discount reduces merchant discount rate, MSF waiver eliminates merchant service fees, IRF adjustment modifies interchange reimbursement fee pass-through, volume incentive provides tiered pricing based on transaction volume, promotional is temporary campaign pricing, custom is bespoke arrangement.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all fee amounts in this exception record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: max_transaction_amount
attributes.description: The maximum transaction amount for which this exception applies. Null if no maximum threshold.

attributes.name: mcc_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of four-digit MCC codes to which this exception applies. Null if mcc_scope is 'all'.

attributes.name: mcc_scope
attributes.description: Defines whether the exception applies to specific MCC codes, a range of MCCs, or all merchant categories.

attributes.name: min_transaction_amount
attributes.description: The minimum transaction amount required for this exception to apply. Null if no minimum threshold.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to this pricing exception.

attributes.name: rate_discount_bps
attributes.description: The discount granted expressed in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%). Calculated as (standard_rate_percent - exception_rate_percent) * 10000. Used for revenue impact analysis.

attributes.name: revenue_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the revenue impact estimate.

attributes.name: revenue_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue impact (reduction) of granting this exception, calculated at time of approval. Used for financial planning and exception portfolio management.

attributes.name: standard_fixed_fee_amount
attributes.description: The standard per-transaction fixed fee (Merchant Service Fee component) that would normally apply before the exception.

attributes.name: standard_rate_percent
attributes.description: The standard Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) or percentage-based fee that would normally apply before the exception. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0275 for 2.75%).

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required to terminate this pricing exception, as specified in the contract.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The transaction channel or entry mode to which this exception applies. Value 'all' indicates exception applies to all transaction types.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this pricing exception record was last modified.

attributes.name: volume_tier_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the volume tier threshold.

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum monthly or annual transaction volume required to qualify for this exception. Used for volume-based incentive pricing.

products.name: volume_tier_threshold
products.description: Volume tier threshold configuration defining the transaction volume or TPV (Total Payment Volume) bands that trigger tiered interchange rates, MDR discounts, or scheme fee rebates. Captures tier level, lower volume bound, upper volume bound, applicable rate or discount, fee type, scheme or acquirer identifier, and effective date. Enables dynamic pricing adjustments based on merchant volume performance.

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the volume tier threshold configuration record.

attributes.name: acquirer_id
attributes.description: Acquiring bank or payment service provider identifier for acquirer-specific tier configurations. Null indicates tier applies across all acquirers.

attributes.name: acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.acquiring_portfolio_pricing. Business justification: Volume tier thresholds are part of a portfolio pricing configuration; adds acquiring_portfolio_pricing_id FK

attributes.name: issuer_id
attributes.description: Issuing bank identifier for issuer-specific tier configurations. Null indicates tier applies across all issuers.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Card scheme or payment network identifier (e.g., VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX, DISCOVER) to which this tier applies. Null indicates tier applies across all schemes.

attributes.name: superseded_by_tier_volume_tier_threshold_id
attributes.description: Reference to the volume_tier_threshold_id that replaces this configuration when a new version is published. Null if this is the current active version.

attributes.name: applicable_fixed_fee
attributes.description: Fixed fee amount per transaction that applies when this tier threshold is met.

attributes.name: applicable_rate_percent
attributes.description: Interchange rate percentage or MDR percentage that applies when this tier threshold is met. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this tier configuration before it becomes effective.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who approved this tier configuration for production use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tier configuration was approved.

attributes.name: card_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier applies to card-present transactions (True), card-not-present transactions (False), or both (Null).

attributes.name: card_product_tier
attributes.description: Card product tier or brand level (e.g., standard, gold, platinum, signature, infinite, world elite). Null indicates tier applies to all product tiers.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Type of payment card this tier applies to (debit, credit, prepaid, commercial). Null indicates tier applies to all card types.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the geographic market this tier applies to. Null indicates tier applies globally.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this volume tier threshold record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier applies to cross-border transactions (True), domestic transactions (False), or both (Null).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary thresholds (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for non-monetary thresholds.

attributes.name: discount_rate_percent
attributes.description: Discount percentage applied to standard rates when merchant qualifies for this volume tier. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0050 for 0.50% discount).

attributes.name: durbin_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier applies to Durbin Amendment regulated debit transactions (True), non-regulated transactions (False), or both (Null).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this volume tier threshold configuration expires and is no longer applied. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this volume tier threshold configuration becomes effective and begins applying to merchant or issuer volume calculations.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Type of fee structure this tier applies to: IRF (Interchange Reimbursement Fee), MDR (Merchant Discount Rate), MSF (Merchant Service Fee), scheme fee, or assessment fee.

attributes.name: lower_bound
attributes.description: Minimum volume threshold value required to qualify for this tier (inclusive). Null indicates no lower limit.

attributes.name: measurement_period
attributes.description: Time period over which volume is measured to determine tier qualification (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual, rolling 30 days). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|rolling_30_days|rolling_90_days — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the threshold bounds (count for transaction volume, currency_amount for TPV, percentage for rate-based thresholds).

attributes.name: merchant_category_code
attributes.description: Four-digit MCC that this tier applies to. Null indicates tier applies across all MCCs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, business rationale, or special instructions for this volume tier threshold configuration.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple tier configurations could apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: Fixed rebate amount provided to merchant or issuer when this volume tier is achieved during the measurement period.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Regional market identifier for multi-country tier configurations (e.g., EMEA, APAC, LATAM). Null indicates no regional restriction.

attributes.name: threshold_type
attributes.description: Type of volume measurement used to determine tier qualification (transaction count, TPV amount, monthly volume, annual volume, or quarterly volume).

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the volume tier (e.g., TIER_1, TIER_GOLD, TIER_PLATINUM).

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier within the pricing structure, where lower numbers typically represent entry-level tiers and higher numbers represent premium tiers.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the volume tier (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum).

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the volume tier threshold configuration.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction this tier applies to (purchase, refund, cash advance, balance inquiry). Null indicates tier applies to all transaction types.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this volume tier threshold record was last modified.

attributes.name: upper_bound
attributes.description: Maximum volume threshold value for this tier (exclusive). Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this tier configuration, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit requirements.

products.name: interchange_dispute
products.description: Interchange-specific dispute record tracking disagreements between acquirers and issuers (or between the platform and card schemes) over interchange fee amounts, rate category misapplication, or downgrade decisions. Captures dispute reference, disputed transaction or billing period, claimed interchange amount, scheme-reported amount, dispute reason code, filing date, resolution date, resolution outcome, and financial adjustment amount.

attributes.name: interchange_dispute_id

attributes.name: billing_period_id

attributes.name: compliance_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_compliance_case. Business justification: Interchange disputes are investigated as compliance cases; linking provides case tracking, resolution status, and auditability.

attributes.name: disputed_transaction_id

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id

attributes.name: issuing_bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the issuing bank or card issuer involved in the interchange dispute.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant associated with the disputed transaction or billing period.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the card scheme entity involved in the interchange dispute.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.scheme_invoice. Business justification: Interchange disputes are linked to the underlying scheme invoice; adds scheme_invoice_id FK

attributes.name: arn

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by the interchange dispute, applicable when the dispute relates to aggregated billing.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by the interchange dispute, applicable when the dispute relates to aggregated billing.

attributes.name: bin
