attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rule configuration is currently active and being applied in dispute processing workflows.

attributes.name: last_executed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rule was last executed in a dispute processing workflow, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: max_dispute_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of disputes this rule can process within a defined time window, used for rate limiting or risk control.

attributes.name: merchant_segment
attributes.description: Merchant classification or segment to which this rule applies, enabling segment-specific dispute handling strategies. May reference MCC (Merchant Category Code) ranges or internal merchant tiers.

attributes.name: mid
attributes.description: Specific Merchant Identification Number to which this rule applies. Null indicates the rule applies broadly per merchant segment or globally.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the user or system process that last modified this rule configuration record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dispute rule configuration record was last modified, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: notification_recipient_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses or user identifiers to be notified when this rule is triggered.

attributes.name: notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a notification must be sent to stakeholders when this rule is triggered.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for rule evaluation order when multiple rules may apply to the same dispute. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Chargeback or dispute reason code to which this rule applies. May be a specific code or a wildcard pattern for multiple codes. Aligns with card scheme reason code taxonomies.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the dispute rule configuration, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the rule logic, business rationale, and intended use case for this dispute rule configuration.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the dispute rule configuration describing its purpose and scope.

attributes.name: rule_owner
attributes.description: Business owner or team responsible for maintaining and governing this dispute rule configuration.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dispute rule configuration indicating whether it is actively applied in dispute processing.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dispute rule configuration indicating the type of automated action or decision logic it governs.

attributes.name: success_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of successful rule executions where the rule conditions were met and the action was successfully applied.

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: Monetary threshold value that triggers or qualifies the rule action. Used for auto-accept or auto-representment eligibility based on dispute amount.

attributes.name: threshold_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the threshold amount.

attributes.name: time_window_hours
attributes.description: Time window in hours for evaluating max dispute count or other time-bound rule conditions.

attributes.name: transaction_age_threshold_days
attributes.description: Maximum age of the original transaction in days for this rule to apply, used for representment eligibility assessment.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this rule configuration, incremented with each modification to support audit trail and rollback capabilities.

attributes.name: win_rate_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Minimum historical win rate percentage for similar disputes required for auto-representment eligibility under this rule.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the user or system process that created this rule configuration record.

products.name: ratio_monitor
products.description: Operational monitoring record tracking a merchant's chargeback ratio against card scheme program thresholds (Visa VDMP, Mastercard MCP) on a monthly basis. Captures monitor record ID, MID, monitoring period month, total transaction count, total chargeback count, chargeback ratio percentage, scheme program threshold breached (standard, excessive), program enrollment date, remediation plan reference, and scheme notification date. Distinct from analytics — this is the operational compliance record used to manage merchant scheme program status.
products.reference: Visa VDMP / Mastercard MCP Program Rules

attributes.name: ratio_monitor_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ratio_monitor

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Chargeback ratio monitoring uses scheme‑specific limits; reference provides those limits.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.scheme. Business justification: Chargeback ratio monitoring is performed per scheme; scheme_id enables the Ratio Monitoring Report used for compliance.

attributes.name: acquirer_notification_date
attributes.description: The date the acquiring bank notified the merchant of the chargeback ratio threshold breach and required remediation actions.

attributes.name: assessment_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary penalty or assessment fee imposed by the card scheme for the chargeback ratio threshold breach during this monitoring period. Fees escalate with severity and duration of non-compliance.
attributes.references: Visa VDMP Fee Schedule, Mastercard MCP Fee Schedule

attributes.name: assessment_fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the assessment fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: chargeback_ratio_percentage
attributes.description: The calculated chargeback ratio expressed as a percentage: (total_chargeback_count / total_transaction_count) * 100. Core metric for determining scheme program threshold breaches.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the merchant with respect to card scheme chargeback ratio requirements for this monitoring period.

attributes.name: consecutive_months_in_program
attributes.description: The number of consecutive months the merchant has been enrolled in the chargeback monitoring program as of this monitoring period. Used to track escalation and potential termination risk.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chargeback ratio monitoring record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: excessive_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The excessive chargeback ratio threshold percentage defined by the card scheme program for this monitoring period. Typically 1.8% for Visa VDMP excessive threshold.

attributes.name: fraud_chargeback_count
attributes.description: The subset of total chargebacks that were classified as fraud-related (reason codes 10.4, 4837, etc.) during the monitoring period. Used for Visa Fraud Monitoring Program (VFM) tracking.
attributes.references: Visa VFM, Card Scheme Reason Codes

attributes.name: fraud_ratio_percentage
attributes.description: The calculated fraud chargeback ratio expressed as a percentage: (fraud_chargeback_count / total_transaction_count) * 100. Used for Visa Fraud Monitoring Program (VFM) compliance.

attributes.name: high_risk_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the merchant is classified as high-risk by the acquirer or card scheme, which may result in stricter chargeback ratio thresholds or enhanced monitoring.

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Four-digit code classifying the merchants business type. Certain MCCs have different chargeback ratio thresholds or heightened monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: mid
attributes.description: Unique merchant identifier assigned by the acquiring bank. Links this monitoring record to the specific merchant being tracked for chargeback ratio compliance.

attributes.name: minimum_chargeback_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of chargebacks required during the monitoring period for the merchant to be subject to the chargeback monitoring program. Typically 100 chargebacks for Visa VDMP standard threshold.

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of transactions required during the monitoring period for the merchant to be subject to the chargeback monitoring program. Typically 1,000 transactions for Visa VDMP.

attributes.name: monitoring_period_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which this chargeback ratio is calculated and monitored. Typically the first day of the month (YYYY-MM-01 format).

attributes.name: monitoring_program_type
attributes.description: The specific card scheme chargeback monitoring program under which this merchant is being tracked. Examples: VDMP (Visa Dispute Monitoring Program), VFM (Visa Fraud Monitoring), MCP (Mastercard Chargeback Program), ECMP (Excessive Chargeback Merchant Program).
attributes.references: Visa VDMP Rules, Mastercard MCP Standards

attributes.name: monitoring_record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this monitoring record. Active indicates ongoing monitoring; Closed indicates the monitoring period has concluded; Under Review indicates pending scheme or acquirer review.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, comments, or context regarding this monitoring record, remediation efforts, or communications with the merchant or card scheme.

attributes.name: program_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the merchant was enrolled into the card scheme chargeback monitoring program due to threshold breach. Null if merchant is not currently enrolled.

attributes.name: program_exit_date
attributes.description: The date the merchant successfully exited the card scheme chargeback monitoring program by achieving compliance. Null if merchant is still enrolled or was never enrolled.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code where the merchant operates. Card scheme monitoring programs may have regional variations in thresholds and rules.

attributes.name: remediation_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the merchants chargeback remediation plan submitted to address the threshold breach. Required for merchants enrolled in monitoring programs.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the rolling review period used to calculate the chargeback ratio.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the rolling review period used to calculate the chargeback ratio. Card schemes typically use a rolling 12-month or 6-month window.

attributes.name: scheme_notification_date
attributes.description: The date the card scheme officially notified the acquirer and merchant of the chargeback ratio threshold breach and program enrollment.

attributes.name: standard_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The standard chargeback ratio threshold percentage defined by the card scheme program for this monitoring period. Typically 0.9% for Visa VDMP standard threshold.

attributes.name: threshold_level_breached
attributes.description: The severity level of the chargeback ratio threshold breach, if any. Indicates which tier of the card scheme monitoring program the merchant has entered. None indicates compliance; other values indicate escalating severity.
attributes.references: Visa VDMP Thresholds, Mastercard MCP Thresholds

attributes.name: total_chargeback_count
attributes.description: The total number of chargebacks received against the merchant during the monitoring period month. Numerator for chargeback ratio calculation.

attributes.name: total_transaction_count
attributes.description: The total number of transactions processed by the merchant during the monitoring period month. Denominator for chargeback ratio calculation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chargeback ratio monitoring record was last modified. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

products.name: dispute_compliance_case
products.description: Card scheme compliance case record initiated when a merchant or acquirer violates scheme rules related to dispute handling — excessive chargebacks, non-compliance with representment procedures, or failure to meet scheme program requirements. Captures compliance case ID, scheme case reference, scheme (Visa, Mastercard), violation type, MID, acquirer BIN, violation period, assessed fine amount, currency, fine due date, payment status, remediation requirement, and case closure date.

attributes.name: dispute_compliance_case_id
attributes.description: Primary key for compliance_case

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Compliance cases depend on scheme‑defined violation criteria; reference needed for accurate assessment.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary dispute record that triggered or is associated with this compliance case, if applicable.

attributes.name: dispute_dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary dispute record that triggered or is associated with this compliance case, if applicable.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name of the internal compliance officer assigned to manage and resolve the compliance case.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant associated with the compliance violation.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.scheme. Business justification: Compliance cases reference specific scheme violations; scheme_id is essential for regulatory filing and scheme‑level audit trails.

attributes.name: acquirer_bin
attributes.description: Bank Identification Number of the acquiring bank responsible for the merchant under compliance review.

attributes.name: acquirer_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique 23-character reference number assigned by the acquiring bank to track the transaction lifecycle, used for linking compliance cases to specific transaction disputes.

attributes.name: assessed_fine_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fine amount assessed by the card scheme for the compliance violation.

attributes.name: case_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance case was officially closed by the card scheme after all requirements were met.

attributes.name: case_closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason code indicating why the compliance case was closed (e.g., remediation completed, fine paid, violation resolved, case withdrawn, escalated to arbitration).

attributes.name: case_opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance case was officially opened by the card scheme or internal compliance team.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance case (e.g., open, under review, pending response, remediation in progress, closed, escalated).

attributes.name: chargeback_count
attributes.description: Total number of chargebacks associated with the merchant during the violation period that contributed to the compliance case.

attributes.name: chargeback_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of chargebacks to total transactions for the merchant during the violation period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0125 for 1.25%).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance case record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation level of the compliance case within the internal compliance management hierarchy (e.g., level 1, level 2, level 3, executive escalation).

attributes.name: fine_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the assessed fine amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fine_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the assessed fine must be paid to the card scheme to avoid further penalties.

attributes.name: fine_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the assessed fine was fully paid to the card scheme.

attributes.name: fine_payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the assessed fine (e.g., unpaid, partially paid, paid, waived, disputed).

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments regarding the compliance case, remediation efforts, and communications with the card scheme.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance case record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: pci_dss_violation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Violation Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the compliance case involves a PCI DSS data security violation (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: PCI Security Standards Council, PCI DSS

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the compliance case requires regulatory reporting to authorities such as FinCEN, CFPB, or FCA (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: remediation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when all required remediation actions were completed and accepted by the card scheme.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which the required remediation actions must be completed and submitted to the card scheme.

attributes.name: remediation_requirement
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions and remediation steps required by the card scheme to resolve the compliance violation and prevent recurrence.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation efforts (e.g., not started, in progress, submitted, accepted by scheme, rejected).

attributes.name: scheme_case_reference_number
attributes.description: External case reference number assigned by the card scheme (Visa, Mastercard) for tracking the compliance violation case.

attributes.name: scheme_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the card scheme representative managing the compliance case.

attributes.name: scheme_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the card scheme representative or contact person managing the compliance case on behalf of the scheme.

attributes.name: scheme_threshold_breached
attributes.description: Description of the specific card scheme threshold or program requirement that was breached (e.g., Visa Fraud Monitoring Program threshold, Mastercard Excessive Chargeback Merchant threshold).
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Standards and Compliance

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific scheme rule violation, including context and circumstances that led to the compliance case.

attributes.name: violation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period during which the scheme rule violations occurred.

attributes.name: violation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period during which the scheme rule violations occurred.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Category of scheme rule violation that triggered the compliance case (e.g., excessive chargebacks, non-compliance with representment procedures, scheme program requirement failures).
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Standards and Compliance

products.name: claim
products.description: Cardholder-initiated dispute claim record capturing the consumer's assertion of a transaction problem before or during the formal chargeback process. Captures claim ID, cardholder account reference, disputed transaction ARN, claim type (unauthorized transaction, item not received, item not as described, duplicate charge, credit not processed), claim submission channel (mobile app, call center, online portal), claim date, claim amount, supporting statement, and initial triage outcome. Represents the consumer-facing entry point into the dispute lifecycle.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Primary key for claim

attributes.name: assigned_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service or dispute resolution agent assigned to handle this claim.

attributes.name: cardholder_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cardholder account that initiated the dispute claim.

attributes.name: chargeback_case_chargeback_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal chargeback case record if this claim was escalated to the chargeback process.

attributes.name: chargeback_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal chargeback case record if this claim was escalated to the chargeback process.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service or dispute resolution agent assigned to handle this claim.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant involved in the disputed transaction.

attributes.name: payment_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.payment_product. Business justification: Cardholder dispute claims are analyzed per payment_product to assess product‑level risk and offer product‑specific resolutions.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.scheme. Business justification: Cardholder dispute claims are adjudicated under a card scheme; scheme_id links each claim to the governing scheme for settlement.

attributes.name: wallet_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wallet.wallet_transaction. Business justification: Cardholder dispute claims often stem from a specific wallet transaction; linking claim to wallet_transaction enables claim validation and settlement.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the claim was resolved (approved, denied, or withdrawn).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the cardholder is claiming as disputed, which may differ from the full transaction amount if disputing a partial charge.

attributes.name: cardholder_statement
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the cardholder describing the reason for the dispute and supporting details.
attributes.references: Regulation E, CFPB Consumer Complaint Handling

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique claim identifier provided to the cardholder for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dispute claim: submitted, under review, pending documentation, approved, denied, withdrawn, or escalated to chargeback. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|pending_documentation|approved|denied|withdrawn|escalated_to_chargeback — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dispute claim based on the nature of the cardholders assertion: unauthorized transaction, item not received, item not as described, duplicate charge, credit not processed, or service not rendered.
attributes.references: Regulation E, Visa Dispute Resolution Rules, Mastercard Chargeback Guide

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: The number of times the dispute resolution team attempted to contact the cardholder for additional information or clarification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this claim record was first created in the dispute management system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the claim and disputed transaction amounts.

attributes.name: disputed_transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the original transaction that is being disputed by the cardholder.

attributes.name: disputed_transaction_date
attributes.description: The original transaction date of the payment being disputed by the cardholder.

attributes.name: documentation_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the document management system where supporting evidence files are stored.

attributes.name: escalated_to_chargeback_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this claim was escalated to a formal chargeback filing with the card network.

attributes.name: expected_resolution_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the claim investigation and resolution is expected to be completed, based on regulatory timelines and internal SLAs.
attributes.references: Regulation E, Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the claim was flagged as potentially fraudulent and routed to the fraud investigation team.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by the fraud detection platform, ranging from 0.00 (low risk) to 100.00 (high risk).

attributes.name: initial_triage_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the initial automated or manual triage assessment: accepted for review, rejected due to insufficient information, rejected as out of timeframe, escalated to fraud investigation, or provisional credit issued.
attributes.references: Regulation E, Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: last_contact_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent contact attempt or successful communication with the cardholder regarding this claim.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this claim record was last updated in the dispute management system.

attributes.name: merchant_category_code
attributes.description: Four-digit code classifying the type of goods or services provided by the merchant involved in the disputed transaction.

attributes.name: provisional_credit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of provisional credit issued to the cardholder, if applicable.

attributes.name: provisional_credit_date
attributes.description: The date on which provisional credit was posted to the cardholder account.

attributes.name: provisional_credit_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a provisional credit was issued to the cardholder account while the claim is under investigation, as required by Regulation E for certain dispute types.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this claim must be included in regulatory reporting submissions to CFPB, card networks, or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database, Regulation E

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes documenting the investigation findings, decision rationale, and resolution details.

attributes.name: resolution_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the claim resolution outcome, aligned with card scheme reason code taxonomies.
attributes.references: Visa Dispute Resolution Rules, Mastercard Chargeback Guide

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the cardholder submitted the dispute claim: mobile app, call center, online portal, branch, email, or chat.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cardholder submitted the dispute claim, representing the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_provided_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the cardholder provided supporting documentation (receipts, correspondence, delivery confirmations) with the claim submission.

attributes.name: transaction_arn
attributes.description: The 23-digit Acquirer Reference Number uniquely identifying the disputed transaction across the payment network.

attributes.name: triage_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the initial triage assessment was completed.

products.name: merchant_response
products.description: Merchant-submitted response record to a dispute notification or retrieval request, capturing the merchant's position and supporting documentation prior to formal representment. Captures response ID, dispute case ID, MID, merchant response date, response type (accept liability, contest dispute, partial acceptance), merchant rebuttal narrative, evidence submitted flag, response channel, and acquirer review status. Distinct from representment — this is the merchant's raw input before the acquirer packages the formal representment.

attributes.name: merchant_response_id
attributes.description: Primary key for merchant_response

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Merchant responses must align with scheme‑specific rebuttal rules; reference ensures correct mapping.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent dispute case that this merchant response addresses. Links to the dispute lifecycle record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the acquirer staff member or system user who reviewed and approved or rejected the merchant response.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this merchant response record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant submitting the response. Links to merchant master data.

attributes.name: representment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal representment record created from this merchant response if the acquirer approved it for submission to the issuer. Null if not yet represented.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.scheme. Business justification: Merchant responses must comply with scheme‑specific rebuttal rules; scheme_id provides the reference for compliance checks.

attributes.name: acquirer_feedback_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes or feedback provided by the acquirer reviewer regarding the quality, completeness, or deficiencies of the merchant response.

attributes.name: acquirer_review_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the acquirer completed their review of the merchant response and made a decision on whether to proceed with representment.

attributes.name: acquirer_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the acquirers internal review of the merchant response. Indicates whether the response meets quality standards for formal representment to the issuer.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: Unique 23-digit reference number assigned by the acquirer to the original transaction. Used to link the response to the specific transaction under dispute.

attributes.name: automated_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this response was generated automatically by the merchants dispute management system or submitted manually by a merchant representative. True if automated.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder who initiated the dispute. Included for merchant reference and evidence matching purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this merchant response record was first created in the dispute management system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the merchant was first notified of the dispute or retrieval request. Used to calculate response deadline and track merchant response time.

attributes.name: evidence_document_count
attributes.description: Total number of supporting documents or evidence files submitted by the merchant as part of this response package.

attributes.name: evidence_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merchant has attached supporting documentation or evidence files to substantiate their response. True if evidence package is included.

attributes.name: evidence_type_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of evidence types included in the response package (e.g., receipt, delivery_confirmation, customer_signature, terms_and_conditions, communication_log).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this merchant response record was last updated. Tracks changes throughout the response lifecycle from draft to final submission.

attributes.name: liability_acceptance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount that the merchant accepts liability for in cases of partial acceptance. Null if merchant contests the full dispute amount.

attributes.name: liability_acceptance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the liability acceptance amount. Typically matches the original transaction currency.

attributes.name: merchant_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the merchant representative for follow-up communication regarding this response.

attributes.name: merchant_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchant representative or contact person who prepared and submitted this response.

attributes.name: merchant_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the merchant representative for urgent communication regarding this response.

attributes.name: merchant_rebuttal_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the merchant describing their position, justification, and defense against the dispute claim. May include transaction details, customer interaction history, and policy references.

attributes.name: original_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the original transaction under dispute. Provided for merchant reference and partial acceptance calculations.

attributes.name: original_transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction under dispute.

attributes.name: original_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the original payment transaction that is the subject of the dispute. Included for merchant reference and evidence correlation.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Card scheme reason code associated with the original dispute that this response addresses. Used to determine required evidence types and response strategy.

attributes.name: representment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merchant response qualifies for formal representment to the issuer based on acquirer review, evidence quality, and card scheme rules. True if eligible.

attributes.name: response_channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the merchant submitted their response to the acquirer (e.g., dispute management portal, API integration, email submission).

attributes.name: response_confidence_score
attributes.description: Automated confidence score (0-100) indicating the predicted likelihood of winning the dispute based on evidence quality, reason code, and historical outcomes. Used for prioritization and strategy.

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which the merchant must submit their response to preserve representment rights per card scheme rules. Typically 7-30 days from dispute notification.

attributes.name: response_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the merchant rebuttal narrative and evidence were submitted.

attributes.name: response_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this merchant response for tracking and correspondence purposes.

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the merchant response in the dispute workflow. Tracks progression from draft through acquirer review to final disposition.

attributes.name: response_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the merchant formally submitted the response to the acquirer for review. Critical for deadline tracking and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: response_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between dispute notification and merchant response submission. Used for performance tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: response_type
attributes.description: Classification of the merchants position in response to the dispute notification. Indicates whether merchant accepts, contests, or partially accepts the chargeback claim.

attributes.name: response_version_number
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions to the merchant response. Incremented each time the merchant updates their response before final submission.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merchant response was submitted after the deadline, resulting in automatic forfeiture of representment rights. True if deadline missed.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the merchant for withdrawing their response and accepting liability. Null if no withdrawal requested.

attributes.name: withdrawal_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the merchant has requested to withdraw this response and accept the chargeback liability. True if withdrawal requested.

products.name: dispute_notification
products.description: Outbound notification record sent to merchants, acquirers, or cardholders at key dispute lifecycle milestones — chargeback received, representment deadline approaching, arbitration decision issued, financial adjustment posted. Captures notification ID, dispute case ID, recipient type, recipient reference, notification channel (email, API webhook, portal alert, SFTP file), notification event type, send timestamp, delivery status, and acknowledgment timestamp. Supports SLA-driven communication obligations.

attributes.name: dispute_notification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dispute notification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Notifications include scheme‑specific language and deadlines; linking standardizes content.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent dispute case that triggered this notification. Links notification to the underlying chargeback, retrieval request, or arbitration case.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: The unique Merchant Identification Number (MID) of the merchant involved in the dispute. Populated when recipient_type is merchant.

attributes.name: scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.scheme. Business justification: Dispute notifications include scheme context for routing and regulatory logging; scheme_id enables accurate notification analytics.

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the message template used to generate this notification, enabling template performance tracking and version control.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the recipient acknowledged the notification: email open tracking, link click, webhook callback, portal view, API response, or manual confirmation.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recipient acknowledged receipt or opened the notification (e.g., email open, webhook callback, portal view). Null if not acknowledged. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: The 23-digit Acquirer Reference Number linking this notification to the original transaction and dispute case per card scheme standards.

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: The full text content of the notification message, including event details, action items, deadlines, and instructions.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the notification was delivered: email, API webhook, portal alert (in-app notification), SFTP file (batch file delivery), SMS, or fax.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the notification: pending (queued for send), sent (transmitted to channel), delivered (confirmed receipt by recipient system), failed (transmission error), bounced (recipient address invalid), rejected (recipient system refused).

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the notification was confirmed delivered to the recipient system or mailbox. Null if not yet delivered. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount in dispute that is the subject of this notification. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: dispute_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the dispute amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: The card scheme reason code for the dispute that triggered this notification (e.g., Visa reason code 10.4, Mastercard reason code 4853). Enables recipient to understand the dispute type.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: The specific dispute lifecycle milestone that triggered this notification: chargeback received, representment deadline approaching, arbitration decision issued, financial adjustment posted, retrieval request received, or case closed.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the notification delivery failed, including error codes and system messages. Null if delivery was successful.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code in which the notification content was generated (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish, fr for French).

attributes.name: last_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent retry attempt. Null if no retries occurred. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notification_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of the notification: draft (being prepared), scheduled (queued for send), sent (transmitted), delivered (confirmed receipt), acknowledged (recipient confirmed), failed (delivery unsuccessful), cancelled (notification voided before send). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|scheduled|sent|delivered|acknowledged|failed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The urgency level of the notification: critical (immediate action required, deadline imminent), high (action required soon), normal (informational with action needed), low (informational only).

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: Primary email address where the notification was sent. Used for email channel notifications.

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: The legal or business name of the notification recipient (merchant name, bank name, cardholder name, partner name).

attributes.name: recipient_reference_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the recipient entity (MID for merchant, institution ID for acquirer/issuer, customer ID for cardholder, partner ID for partner). Format varies by recipient type.

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Classification of the notification recipient: merchant (the business being notified), acquirer (acquiring bank), cardholder (end consumer), issuer (issuing bank), partner (third-party service provider), or internal (internal operations team).

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique reference number for this notification, used for tracking and acknowledgment by recipients.

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which the recipient must respond to the dispute event (e.g., representment deadline, evidence submission deadline). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of times the system attempted to resend this notification after initial delivery failure. Zero indicates successful first-attempt delivery.

attributes.name: scheduled_send_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the notification was originally scheduled to be sent. May differ from actual send_timestamp if delays occurred. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: send_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the notification was sent from the system to the recipient channel. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: sftp_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the notification file deposited on the SFTP server. Populated only for sftp_file channel notifications.

attributes.name: sftp_file_path
attributes.description: The full file path on the SFTP server where the notification file was deposited. Populated only for sftp_file channel notifications.

attributes.name: sla_deadline_timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual or regulatory deadline by which this notification must be delivered to meet Service Level Agreement (SLA) obligations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules, Mastercard Rules, Internal SLA Standards

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the notification was delivered within the SLA deadline. True if delivered on time, False if SLA was breached.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: The subject line or title of the notification message, summarizing the event and action required.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: webhook_response_body
attributes.description: The response payload returned by the recipient webhook endpoint, used for troubleshooting and confirmation tracking. Null for non-webhook channels.

attributes.name: webhook_response_code
attributes.description: The HTTP response status code returned by the recipient webhook endpoint (e.g., 200 for success, 4xx for client error, 5xx for server error). Null for non-webhook channels.

attributes.name: webhook_url
attributes.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL where the API webhook notification was posted. Populated only for api_webhook channel notifications.

products.name: fee
products.description: Fee record for all charges assessed in connection with dispute processing — scheme chargeback fees, arbitration filing fees, compliance assessment fines, retrieval request fees, and internal processing fees. Captures fee ID, dispute case ID, fee type, fee amount, currency, fee assessed by (scheme, acquirer, internal), fee assessment date, billing period, invoice reference, payment status, and waiver flag. Distinct from dispute_financial_adjustment which tracks transaction-level debits/credits; this tracks fee-based charges.

attributes.name: fee_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fee

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Fee assessment rules vary by card scheme; reference needed for correct fee calculation.

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent dispute case record to which this fee is associated. Links the fee to the full dispute lifecycle including chargeback filings, representment, and arbitration.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Entity that assessed or levied this fee. Identifies whether the fee originates from a card scheme (Visa, Mastercard), an acquiring bank, an issuing bank, the payment network, or is an internally generated processing charge.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Federal Reserve System Regulation E

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Dispute fee expense tracking: fees arising from disputes need a GL account for expense recognition and reporting.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fx.fx_rate. Business justification: Dispute fee calculations may be converted; fee reporting needs the exact FX rate applied.

attributes.name: scheme_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule or pricing configuration that determined the assessed fee amount. Links to the applicable scheme fee table or internal pricing rule used to calculate this charge.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Merchant Management System

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the fee assessed in the fee currency. Represents the base charge before any waivers or adjustments. Stored with four decimal places to support multi-currency precision.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ERP - Oracle Financials

attributes.name: amount_usd
attributes.description: Fee amount converted to US Dollars (USD) using the FX rate applied at assessment date. Enables normalized cross-currency reporting and analytics across all dispute fee records.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: Acquirer Reference Number uniquely identifying the original transaction linked to the dispute that generated this fee. Enables end-to-end traceability from fee back to the originating payment transaction per card scheme rules.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: assessing_entity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the specific entity that assessed the fee (e.g., 'Visa Inc.', 'Mastercard International', 'Chase Merchant Services'). Complements assessed_by for reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the fee was formally assessed or levied by the assessing entity. Used as the primary business event date for billing period assignment and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the fee was assessed. Provides sub-day precision for SLA tracking, real-time processing audit, and dispute deadline calculations.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: billing_period
attributes.description: The billing cycle period (YYYY-MM format) to which this fee is attributed for invoicing and financial reporting. Aligns with monthly scheme billing cycles and ERP accounts payable periods.
attributes.references: ERP - Oracle Financials; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center code to which this dispute fee expense is allocated. Supports departmental P&L reporting and internal cost attribution for dispute operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Provides audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the fee amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency dispute processing across 200+ countries.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules

attributes.name: dispute_fee_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by dispute operations staff regarding this fee record. May include waiver justification details, scheme correspondence references, or escalation context.

attributes.name: dispute_stage
attributes.description: Stage of the dispute lifecycle at which this fee was assessed. Identifies whether the fee relates to a retrieval request, first chargeback, second chargeback, pre-arbitration, arbitration, or compliance filing.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual or scheme-mandated deadline by which the fee must be paid. Drives overdue detection, collections escalation, and SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ERP - Oracle Financials

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fee record. Tracks progression from initial assessment through invoicing, payment, waiver, or secondary dispute of the fee itself.
attributes.references: Dispute and Chargeback Management System; ERP - Oracle Financials

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee assessed in connection with the dispute. Distinguishes scheme chargeback fees, arbitration filing fees, compliance assessment fines, retrieval request fees, pre-arbitration fees, and internal processing fees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chargeback_fee|arbitration_fee|compliance_assessment|retrieval_request_fee|internal_processing_fee|pre_arbitration_fee|scheme_penalty|network_fine — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; PCI DSS

attributes.name: fx_rate_applied
attributes.description: The FX exchange rate used to convert the fee amount from the fee currency to USD at the time of assessment. Supports audit trail for currency conversion and DCC-related fee reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SWIFT gpi; ERP - Oracle Financials

attributes.name: invoice_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the invoice or billing statement on which this fee appears. Links the fee record to the ERP accounts payable or accounts receivable invoice for payment tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: mid
attributes.description: Merchant Identification Number of the merchant associated with the disputed transaction that triggered this fee. Used for merchant-level fee reporting, MDR reconciliation, and chargeback ratio monitoring.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Merchant Management System

attributes.name: net_fee_amount
attributes.description: Final collectible fee amount after applying any waivers or adjustments (fee_amount minus waiver_amount). Represents the actual amount due for billing and GL posting.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee was settled or paid. Populated when payment_status transitions to 'paid' or 'partially_paid'. Used for cash flow reporting and aging analysis.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment collection status of the net fee amount. Tracks whether the fee has been paid, remains outstanding, is overdue, or has been written off. Distinct from fee_status which tracks the assessment lifecycle.
attributes.references: ERP - Oracle Financials; SOX; Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this fee record as assigned by the assessing entity (card scheme, acquirer, or internal billing system). Used for reconciliation and invoice matching.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee record must be included in regulatory or compliance reports (e.g., FinCEN, CFPB, or scheme compliance filings). Supports automated regulatory data aggregation.

attributes.name: scheme_reason_code
attributes.description: Card scheme-specific reason code associated with the chargeback or dispute event that triggered this fee (e.g., Visa reason code 10.4, Mastercard reason code 4853). Aligns with ISO 8583 and scheme rule classifications.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; ISO 8583

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this fee record originated. Identifies whether the fee was generated by the Dispute and Chargeback Management System, ERP Oracle Financials, a card scheme network feed, or manual entry.
attributes.references: Dispute and Chargeback Management System; ERP - Oracle Financials; Data Warehouse and Analytics Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fee record in the Silver layer. Supports change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: waiver_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount waived from the original fee_amount. Supports partial waivers where only a portion of the assessed fee is forgiven. Zero if no waiver applied.
attributes.references: ERP - Oracle Financials; Visa Core Rules

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee has been fully waived by the assessing entity. When True, the fee amount is not expected to be collected. Distinct from partial adjustments tracked in fee_waiver_amount.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; Dispute and Chargeback Management System

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the fee was waived. Applicable only when waiver_flag is True. Supports audit and compliance reporting for fee waiver decisions.
attributes.references: Visa Core Rules; Mastercard Rules; SOX

products.name: gateway_api_credential

products.name: gateway_routing_rule
products.description: Business-managed transaction routing rule defining how inbound payment requests are directed to acquirer endpoints. Captures rule priority, matching criteria (BIN range, MCC, currency, amount threshold, card scheme, region), target acquirer endpoint, failover sequence, load-balancing weight, effective date range, and rule status. Supports least-cost routing, scheme-preference routing, and geographic routing strategies.

attributes.name: gateway_routing_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the routing rule.

attributes.name: acquirer_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Primary acquirer endpoint to which matching transactions are routed.

attributes.name: card_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reference_card_scheme. Business justification: Rules may target a specific card scheme; linking to reference_card_scheme provides scheme details and compliance data.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Routing rules are applied per currency; linking to reference.currency enables validation, reporting, and compliance per ISO currency.

attributes.name: ecosystem_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.ecosystem_partner. Business justification: Partners often have custom routing rules; linking enables rule‑ownership reporting, SLA monitoring, and regulatory routing audits.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User or system that created the rule.

attributes.name: irf_rate_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interchange.irf_rate_category. Business justification: Routing: rules need to reference IRF rate categories to apply correct interchange rates per regulatory and scheme requirements.

attributes.name: mcc_id

attributes.name: payment_product_id

products.name: forward_contract
products.description: Master record for FX forward contracts entered into by the platform treasury to hedge future cross-border settlement obligations. Captures the contract reference, counterparty bank, base currency, quote currency, notional amount, contracted forward rate, spot rate at inception, forward points, value date, maturity date, hedge designation (cash flow hedge, fair value hedge), contract status, and settlement instructions. products.name: exposure
products.description: Transactional record capturing the platform's open FX exposure position by currency at a point in time. Records the currency, exposure direction (long/short), gross notional exposure, net exposure after hedges, unhedged exposure, value date, exposure source (pending settlements, nostro balances, forward contracts), and risk limit utilization percentage. Enables treasury to monitor real-time FX risk positions, trigger hedging actions when exposure breaches thresholds, and report FX risk to the board and regulators.

attributes.name: monitor_employee_id

attributes.name: payment_product_id

attributes.name: exposure_status

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the exposure record.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exposure is expected to settle or be realized.

products.name: cross_border_payment
products.description: Core transactional record for every cross-border payment instruction initiated through the platform. Captures the payment reference, originating country, destination country, sender identity, beneficiary identity, beneficiary bank BIC, beneficiary IBAN/account number, payment amount, origination currency, destination currency, FX rate applied, converted amount, payment rail selected (SWIFT, SEPA, local ACH), SWIFT UETR, payment purpose code, regulatory reporting flags, OFAC screening status, and payment lifecycle status. The SSOT for cross-border payment execution within the FX domain.

products.name: multicurrency_settlement

products.name: psd2_fx_disclosure

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `payments_fintech_ecm`.`_metrics`.`cardholder_authentication_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Security and risk metrics derived from authentication events"
  source: "`payments_fintech_ecm`.`cardholder`.`authentication_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "authentication_channel"
      expr: authentication_channel
      comment: "Channel used for authentication (e.g., mobile, web)"
    - name: "authentication_factor"
      expr: authentication_factor
      comment: "Factor used (e.g., password, biometric)"
    - name: "device_type"
      expr: device_type
      comment: "Type of device used for authentication"
    - name: "country_id"
      expr: country_id
      comment: "Country where authentication originated"
    - name: "event_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of the authentication event"
  measures:
    - name: "total_authentication_events"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of authentication events recorded"
    - name: "failed_authentication_events"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN authentication_outcome = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of authentication events that resulted in failure"
    - name: "average_risk_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average risk score across authentication events"
$$
metric_views.description: Security and risk metrics derived from authentication events

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `payments_fintech_ecm`.`_metrics`.`cardholder_account`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core financial health metrics for cardholder accounts"
  source: "`payments_fintech_ecm`.`cardholder`.`cardholder_account`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "account_status"
      expr: account_status
      comment: "Current status of the account (e.g., active, closed)"
    - name: "account_type"
      expr: account_type
      comment: "Type of account (e.g., consumer, corporate)"
    - name: "currency_id"
      expr: currency_id
      comment: "Currency identifier for the account balances"
    - name: "account_created_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the account was created"
  measures:
    - name: "total_current_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total current balance across all cardholder accounts"
    - name: "average_credit_limit"
      expr: AVG(CAST(credit_limit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average credit limit per account"
    - name: "total_available_credit"
      expr: SUM(CAST(available_credit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of available credit across accounts"
    - name: "active_account_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of accounts with active status"
$$
metric_views.description: Core financial health metrics for cardholder accounts

    - name: "total_gross_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_gross AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross amount for all transactions"
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_net AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net amount after fees and adjustments"
    - name: "transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of transaction records"
    - name: "declined_transaction_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN decline_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions that were declined"
    - name: "fraud_transaction_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions flagged as fraud"
$$
metric_views.description: High‑level transaction KPIs for revenue and risk monitoring
